jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
The Project Coordinator will support the planning, implementation, coordination, and expansion of early wealth\-building initiatives led by the UCLA CalKIDS Institute. Reporting directly to the Principal Investigator and working closely with Institute leadership, the Project Coordinator will serve as the primary liaison between the Institute and a broad network of partners, including community\-based organizations, educational institutions, public agencies, financial capability providers, and statewide coalitions. The primary responsibility of this position will be overseeing the day\-to\-day implementation of the CalKIDS Institute Building Wealth at Tax Time Initiative, a multi\-year effort designed to integrate CalKIDS, 530A ("Trump") Accounts, HOPE Accounts, and other asset\-building opportunities into Volunteer Income Tax Assistance (VITA) and Earned Income Tax Credit (EITC) outreach ecosystems. The Project Coordinator will coordinate and implement partner engagement, training, outreach, data collection, and ongoing communication with participating VITA coalitions and community partners. In addition to supporting the Building Wealth at Tax Time Initiative, the Project Coordinator will contribute to other Institute activities related to early wealth building, including development and dissemination of training resources, stakeholder engagement, research implementation, community outreach, policy initiatives, convenings, and partnerships that advance financial resilience and asset\-building opportunities for low\-income households. The position requires strong project management, relationship\-building, communication, and organizational skills, as well as the ability to manage multiple initiatives and work effectively with diverse stakeholders across California.  

**Salary \& Compensation**
  

  

\*UCLA provides a full pay range. Actual salary offers consider factors, including budget, prior experience, skills, knowledge, abilities, education, licensure and certifications, and other business considerations. Salary offers at the top of the range are not common. Visit UC Benefit package to discover benefits that start on day one, and UC Total Compensation Estimator to calculate the total compensation value with benefits.
  

**Qualifications**  

  

* Experience in coordinating programs, projects, partnerships, or community\-based initiatives. (Required)


* Experience coordinating meetings, trainings, workshops, or community engagement activities. (Required)


* Experience collecting, organizing, tracking, and reporting project information and performance metrics. (Required)


* Experience working with low\-income communities, financial capability programs, asset\-building initiatives, Volunteer Income Tax Assistance (VITA) programs, workforce development programs, educational programs, or related community\-based services. (Preferred)


* Experience supporting grant\-funded projects and managing project deliverables. (Preferred)


* Experience developing or coordinating training programs, online learning modules, or technical assistance activities. (Preferred)


* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, organize complex activities, and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment. (Required)


* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with diverse audiences. (Required)


* Strong interpersonal skills and demonstrated ability to build and maintain productive relationships with community organizations, public agencies, educational institutions, and other stakeholders. (Required)


* Ability to speak about CalKIDS Institute programs and our impact with community leaders. (Preferred)


* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and virtual meeting platforms. (Required)


* Ability to work independently while also functioning effectively as part of a collaborative team. (Required)


* Commitment to advancing economic opportunity, educational equity, financial capability, and community well\-being. (Required)


* Familiarity with data collection, survey administration, program evaluation, or applied research activities. (Preferred)


* Knowledge of California’s early wealth\-building ecosystem, including CalKIDS, ScholarShare 529 plans, children's savings accounts, financial capability initiatives, or related programs. (Preferred)


* Bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish. (Preferred)


  

**Education, Licenses, Certifications \& Personal Affiliations**

jobs.description:
**Design streets that move people\-not just cars.**


At **Toole Design**, we're leading the way in creating safer, more connected communities through sustainable multimodal transportation design. We're looking for a **Project Coordinator** to join our Project Operations team, someone who's energized to support and strengthen impactful transportation projects by keeping project information organized, coordinating administrative processes, and helping project teams stay on track.

 **Why You'll Love Working Here**


We're a purpose\-driven team of technical experts and operations professionals who believe streets should work for *everyone*. At Toole Design, you'll join a collaborative environment where operations professionals work alongside industry leaders, with mentorship and development opportunities designed to help you grow your expertise.

 **We offer:**

* A collaborative, inclusive culture that supports your growth and advancement
* A flexible hybrid schedule: 3 days in the office and 2 days remotely
* 8 paid holidays; and 16 days of PTO accrual annually
* Competitive salary, excellent benefits, and transportation perks: Benefits and Support
* The opportunity to support projects that improve lives\-advancing safe, inclusive design grounded in ethics, empathy, and equity

**What You'll Do**


As a Project Coordinator, you'll provide project coordination and administrative support that helps our project teams remain organized, accurate, and on schedule. You'll assist with project setup, documentation, compliance tracking, invoicing support, and coordination across multiple departments while ensuring project information is current and complete. Your attention to detail, organization, and service\-oriented approach will help teams deliver successful projects.

 **What You Bring:**

* 3–5 years of experience in a business environment, project coordination, or administrative support role, or a business\-focused degree with relevant experience
* Basic knowledge of project management principles
* Basic understanding of Accounts Payable/Receivable processes strongly preferred
* Strong proficiency with Microsoft Excel and the Microsoft Office Suite
* Experience working with an ERP system (Deltek Vantagepoint preferred but not required)
* Experience with Supplier Diversity Management software is preferred but not required
* Excellent organizational, time management, and problem\-solving skills
* Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* A collaborative, service\-oriented approach and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment

 **Join Us. Make an Impact.**


We're proud to be an ENR Top 500 design firm with one of the lowest turnover rates in the industry. If you're ready to do meaningful work with a supportive, talented team\-apply today.

 **We are targeting a salary range of $68,000 to $78,000 for this position with flexibility for well\-qualified candidates.**

 **Apply here! Careers \- Toole Design**

  

Questions, assistance or accommodations? Contact HR@tooledesign.com or call 301\-927\-1900, press 5\.

  

At Toole Design, we foster a collaborative culture and welcome people of all backgrounds to help build more inclusive communities. We strongly encourage women and applicants from underrepresented communities – people of color, LGBTQIA\+, immigrants, first\-generation college students/graduates, those with disabilities and people at all the intersections in between – to apply. We're proud that about half our managers are women and we are committed to diverse leadership that reflects the communities we serve. Toole Design is a woman\-owned, equal opportunity employer (EO/AA/VEV/Disabled employer).

jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Company Overview:**
The SCGA Junior Golf Foundation’s mission is to develop an inclusive golf community that enables kids to thrive on and beyond the course. Through its programs, SCGA Junior Golf Foundation works to fulfill its mission by creating affordable access to golf for all youth, teaching smart decision\-making skills, on and off the course, and developing a culture of healthy lifestyles. Founded in 1983, SCGA Junior Golf Foundation is the philanthropic arm of the Southern California Golf Association. SCGA Junior Golf Foundation’s programs emphasize both player and youth development by providing a fun, safe, and engaging community for players, parents, and coaches. **Position Summary:**
The Program Coordinator is a full\-time, non\-exempt opportunity assisting with the operation, growth, and exposure of the player \& youth development programs (herein PYD) focused in the community. The Program Coordinator and PYD team implement positive youth development, and golf and athlete development programming, for juniors within the community. The Program Coordinator assists with curriculum development, as well as overall growth and development of youth coaches. The incumbent will be assigned to work at various field locations within the defined geographical boundary and community. This position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package, with a starting hourly rate of $24\.00\. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities:*** Accountable for the oversight and implementation of all program and safety policies in San Fernando Valley, including program facilitation at Woodley Lakes, Hansem Dam, and Van Nuys golf courses
* Implements positive youth development and team culture building best practices in all aspects of programming and beyond
* Serves as a lead golf instructor at beginner, intermediate and advanced level programming and other events as necessary while promoting best practices regarding safety and SCGA Junior Golf Foundation policies
* Organizes and develops programming/activities/events in accordance with the SCGA Junior Golf Foundation’s mission and PYD program goals and objectives to include those focused on community building.
* Implements and manages program modifications to ensure program goals are achieved.
* Provides supervision, feedback and training on a regular basis to coaches.
* Recruits, schedules and conducts one\-on\-one lessons.
* Administers equipment fittings.
* Develops and maintains community, facility, stakeholder partnerships and relationships for the benefit of the program.
* Assists in identifying and determining outreach organization partners to develop relationship and to better serve organization goals.
* Participates in professional development which may include positive youth development trainings, Titleist Performance Institute, U.S. Kids Golf seminars and professional golf certifications.
* Ensures goals and objectives are met in areas including customer satisfaction, safety, quality and team member performance.
* Assists in the planning of short and long\-term strategies and objectives.
* Collects, records and produces accurate and timely reports of program data.
* Manages attendance, rosters, equipment inventories and data capture related to all programming.
* Creates, maintains and manages all registration pages.
* Other tasks and duties as relevant and assigned.

 **Minimum Skills and Qualifications:*** Bachelor’s degree in related field of study and/or combination of acceptable education and relative work experience.
* In\-depth knowledge of the game of golf; capable of independently leading intermediate to more advanced programming initiatives.
* Minimum of one (1\) year of experience working in sports or events, operations, administrative, and/or other work environment with similar responsibilities.
* Customer service approach with excellent communication and interpersonal skills; outgoing and comfortable in administering small group presentations.
* Demonstrated proficiency in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint presentations.
* Ability to work independently while also effectively interacting and collaborating with other departments and team members to achieve various organizational goals.
* Able to troubleshoot, pivot and adapt to changing situations and environments.
* Conveys a positive demeanor that is professional and approachable at all times.
* Must be able to stand for prolonged periods of time, to include bending/stooping; able to lift and move up to 25 lbs., and occasionally lift and move up to 50 lbs. with minimal assistance.
* Able to work outdoors for extended periods of time and in various elements of weather.
* Flexible schedule; must be available to work evenings and weekends as required.
* Access to reliable transportation and able to travel with timely arrival to assigned working locations as required.

jobs.title: Social Media Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Social Media Coordinator**

The Social Media Coordinator is responsible for bringing the Los Angeles Ale Works brand to life across social media. This role plans and creates engaging content, manages day\-to\-day publishing and community interaction, and captures the beer, food, events, people, and atmosphere that make each LAAW location distinctive.

The right candidate is creative, organized, comfortable working independently, and energized by being on\-site. This person will work closely with our taprooms, brewery, kitchen, events, and leadership teams to maintain a consistent content calendar and timely social presence. This is a social\-media\-first position; broader marketing projects, may be supported as needed but are not the primary focus of the role. Candidates must share our commitment to quality, craftsmanship, creativity, and authenticity.

The ideal candidate will be knowledgeable about beer, hospitality, Los Angeles culture, social media scheduling platforms, and have experience in project management, writing, photography, and video.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

● Plan and maintain a consistent social media content calendar aligned with beer releases, food specials, events, collaborations, and beer production.

● Create original photography, short\-form video, Stories, Reels, captions, and other platform\-specific content for Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and emerging channels.

● Visit Los Angeles Ale Works locations regularly to gain an understanding of the location and capture authentic, timely content featuring products, guests, employees, events, and behind\-the\-scenes activity.

● Schedule and publish content while maintaining a consistent brand voice, visual style, and level of quality across platforms.

● Monitor comments, messages, tags, reviews, and user\-generated content; respond or route issues to the appropriate team in a timely and professional manner.

● Build community engagement by identifying relevant local conversations, partners, creators, organizations, and cross\-promotional opportunities.

● Coordinate with internal teams to gather accurate information, assets, dates, and priorities for upcoming posts and event coverage.

● Create simple digital graphics and promotional assets for social media using Canva or Adobe.

● Track platform performance and provide clear, practical reporting on reach, engagement, audience growth, and content performance.

● Use performance insights and platform trends to recommend content improvements and test new formats or ideas.

● Maintain an organized library of approved photos, videos, graphics, and reusable content.

● Provide support for related digital and in\-store promotional needs when they directly support social campaigns, beer releases, or events.

● Manage time independently with the ability to toggle between daily and long\-term tasks, keeping workstreams moving forward simultaneously.

● Maintain open lines of communication, patience and professionalism when partnering with cross\-functional teams in a fast\-paced evolving environment.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

● One to three years of experience managing social media or creating content for a hospitality, food and beverage, lifestyle, entertainment, or consumer brand.

● Strong working knowledge of Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Google Business, and common social scheduling and reporting tools.

● Demonstrated photography, short\-form video, editing, and copywriting skills; a portfolio or examples of past work are preferred.

● Proficiency with Canva; working knowledge of Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Lightroom, Premiere Pro, or similar tools.

● Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and able to manage a content calendar, multiple locations, and quick\-turn requests.

● Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across departments.

● Sound judgment when representing a brand publicly and responding to guests online.

● Self\-motivated, social, dependable, and comfortable taking initiative while remaining open to feedback.

● A degree in communications, media, marketing, journalism, or a related field is preferred but not required.

● Flexibility in both schedule and duties; willingness to work weekends, evenings, as needed along with traveling between our Hawthorne, Culver City and Hermosa Beach locations

Pay: $30\.00 \- $35\.00 per hour

Expected hours: No less than 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Flexible schedule
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

Work Location: In person

**Description**  

The Assistant Clinical Research Coordinator (ACRC) contributes to the overall operational management of clinical research/trial/study activities from design, set up, conduct, through closeout. The position has responsibility for the coordination of research activities for one or more studies. The ACRC recognizes and performs necessary tasks to coordinate projects and prioritizes work to meet necessary deadlines. The ACRC participates in planning and organizing necessary tasks to ensure adherence to the study protocol and applicable regulations, such as institutional policy and procedures, FDA Code of Federal Regulations (CFR), and ICH Good Clinical Practice (GCP). The Study Coordinator collaborates with the Principal Investigator (PI), ancillary departments, central research infrastructure teams, sponsors, institutions, and other entities as needed to support the administration of all aspects of studies, including, but not limited to, compliant conduct, financial management, and adequate personnel support. Performance of duties and tasks will vary based on the department operations, the type of study and scope of service.


Salary Range: $30\.74 – 49\.46 Hourly

  

Pay range:
  

**Qualifications** **Required:**

* Minimum of 1\+ years of experience in a clinical research setting
* Interpersonal skills to effectively communicate information in a timely, professional manner and establish and maintain cooperative and effective working relationships with students, staff, faculty, external collaborators and administration and to work as a member of a team.
* Ability to effectively communicate to and interact with patients in a compassionate and kind manner.
* Ability to set priorities and complete ongoing tasks with competing deadlines, with frequent interruptions, to meet the programmatic and department needs, while complying with applicable University policies and federal and state regulations.
* Analytical skills to assess clinical research protocols and regulatory requirements, define problems, formulate logical solutions, develop alternative solutions, make recommendations, and initiate corrective actions.

* Demonstrated proficiency with Adobe and Microsoft suite software, especially Excel, to perform daily tasks efficiently and accurately.
* A learning and professional growth mentality so that new software tools, systems, and processes can be adopted quickly and efficiently.
* Working knowledge of clinical research concepts, policies and procedures, and human safety protection regulations and laws.
* Knowledge of and experience working with a variety of local and external IRBs, scientific review and other research committees, national cooperative group sponsors, industry sponsors, federal and foundation funding organizations, etc.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills to effectively establish rapport, building collaborative relationships, and communicate complex concepts and ideas in an easy\-to\-understand manner.
* Ability to adapt to changing job demands and priorities, remain flexible including working flexible hours to accommodate research deadlines.
* Ability to handle confidential information with judgement and discretion.
* High degree of concentration and focus in a work environment that contains distracting stimuli, competing deadlines, and work delegated by more than one individual.

* Bachelor’s Degree in related areas and/or equivalent combination of education and experience

jobs.title: Facilities & Lab Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Provivi Overview:**



Provivi™ is a California\-based, globally operating AgTech company using pheromones to protect crops from major damaging insects. Our patented production method enables a step change in the cost of manufacturing pheromones, allowing us to pioneer the use of this proven tool in high\-acreage crops such as corn, rice and soy.

  



Founded in 2013 by Nobel laureate Frances Arnold and Caltech scholars Pedro Coelho and Peter Meinhold, we are hiring the very best and brightest people to develop and commercialize our products.

  


**Role Description:**



We are seeking a hands\-on, highly organized, part\-time Facilities \& Lab Operations Coordinator to support the day\-to\-day operation of our Santa Monica facility.

  

This is an onsite role responsible for making sure the workplace and laboratory environment remains safe, organized, supplied, and operational. The Facilities Manager will serve as the primary point person for routine facility needs, vendors, shipping and receiving, supplies, safety checks, and general site coordination.



This role is a good fit for someone who enjoys owning the details behind a well\-run workplace. You'll work closely with our R\&D team and other business functions, taking ownership of facility operations so scientists and other team members can stay focused on their primary work

  

Because this is a working laboratory environment, the role requires comfort operating around laboratory supplies, chemicals, equipment, and established safety procedures. Scientific expertise is not required.

 **Specific Responsibilities Include:**



Facility Operations \& Workplace Readiness


* Serve as the primary onsite point of contact for facility needs, maintenance issues, and day\-to\-day site operations.
* Keep common areas, storage, shipping/receiving, and shared workspaces clean, organized, stocked, and operational.
* Coordinate cleaning, maintenance, dry ice delivery, chemical waste pickup, and other recurring facility services.
* Monitor facility and office supplies, maintain appropriate inventory levels, and reorder as needed.
* Conduct regular site walkthroughs with R\&D and site leadership to identify maintenance needs and opportunities for improvement.


Shipping, Receiving \& Inventory


* Receive incoming packages and materials and route them to the appropriate employees or teams.
* Coordinate outbound shipments, including packaging, shipping documentation, EPA\-compliant product labeling, carrier requirements, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Maintain an organized shipping and receiving area and adequate inventory of shipping supplies.
* Maintain appropriate shipment, packing list, and receiving documentation.
* Partner with Accounting on shipping invoices, approvals, and month\-end inventory needs.


Laboratory \& R\&D Operational Support


* Coordinate routine laboratory supply and vendor needs, including gas tanks, dry ice as needed, and other facility\-supported materials.
* Support chemical and laboratory material receiving, inventory documentation, and storage processes.
* Coordinate chemical and laboratory waste pickup and maintain associated records.
* Monitor equipment maintenance (weight balances, GC machines, deli fridges, etc.) schedules and coordinate service as needed.
* Partner with R\&D on facility needs while leaving scientific and technical decisions with appropriate R\&D team members.


Safety \& Compliance


* Conduct and document routine interior and exterior facility and laboratory safety inspections and escalate concerns promptly.
* Monitor fire extinguishers, medical emergency supply cabinet, eyewash stations, and other facility safety equipment and coordinate required inspections or service.
* Maintain facility safety documentation, including SDS records and applicable vendor and waste documentation. Following up with suppliers in the event an SDS is required on file.
* Coordinate periodic safety walkthroughs with R\&D and other appropriate stakeholders.
* Help ensure facility vendors, storage areas, and routine operations follow established company safety requirements.


Vendor \& Administrative Coordination


* Manage day\-to\-day relationships with cleaning, maintenance, waste, shipping, supply, and other facility vendors.
* Schedule recurring and ad hoc services and follow through to ensure work is completed.
* Review facility\-related invoices and coordinate approvals and documentation with Accounting.
* Receive, sort, and distribute physical mail; scan and digitize documents as appropriate; and electronically route materials to Accounting, HR, Legal, or other teams for review and action.
* Maintain facility records, schedules, and documentation while identifying practical ways to improve reliability, organization, and cost.

  


**Qualifications \& Skills Include:**


* Prior experience in facilities coordination, office/lab operations, workplace operations, or a similar hands\-on operational role.
* Strong organizational skills and comfort managing many small, recurring responsibilities without requiring significant oversight.
* Experience coordinating vendors, supplies, deliveries, shipping, or facility services.
* Ability to identify an issue, determine the appropriate next step, and follow it through to completion.
* Comfortable working onsite in a laboratory/R\&D environment where chemicals and specialized equipment are present.
* Strong attention to safety, documentation, and established procedures.
* Able to perform routine physical aspects of facility operations, including receiving packages, organizing supplies, and moving reasonably sized materials.
* Comfortable working with employees across Supply Chain, R\&D, Accounting, HR, Legal, and other functions.
* Reliable and able to maintain a consistent three\-day\-per\-week onsite schedule.
* Experience supporting a laboratory, biotech, chemical, life\-sciences, or R\&D environment would be particularly helpful, but isn't necess

jobs.title: Transaction Coordinator
jobs.description:
At Compass, our mission is to help everyone find their place in the world. Founded in 2012, we’re revolutionizing the real estate industry with our end\-to\-end platform that empowers residential real estate agents to deliver exceptional service to seller and buyer clients.


As a Transaction Coordinator, you will join the Contract to Close team, which oversees all administrative details throughout the contract process, freeing agents to focus on building client relationships and growing their business. Our Transaction team members are experienced in real estate and serve as the first point of contact for all parties involved, ensuring a smooth path to settlement. From document preparation to deadline tracking to requesting online testimonials, your goal is to make life easier for agents and clients every step of the way. You will also work hand in hand with local lenders and title attorneys, bringing extensive experience and strong industry contacts to every contract you process.
  

**Please note: This position will require you to be in the local office 2x per month.**
  

At Compass, You Will:
* Handle document tracking for a large volume of real estate transactions from listing to close, and/or contract to close, ensuring compliance with brokerage and legal requirements — averaging roughly 25\-30 closings per month
* Ensure real estate contracts are processed properly and promptly, with a focus on the details
* Manage and track contract deadlines to ensure all timelines are met
* Navigate company systems to validate the accuracy of compliance and commission records
* Provide support to Agents in response to inquiries regarding commission payouts, deductions, and commission calculations
* Collaborate with sales managers and other support teams to offer outstanding support to the agents

What We're Looking For:
* Real estate license preferred
* Strong knowledge of the real estate laws in California and familiarity with standard real estate forms used in California (SFAR, PRDS, and Local Area Disclosures)
* In\-depth knowledge of Real Estate Transaction Coordination and Compliance
* DocuSign, Google Suite, CTM
* Strong written, quantitative, verbal, and presentation skills
* Ability to digest detailed contracts and make informed decisions based on content
* Ability to maintain strict confidentiality of agents' contracts
* Work independently and collaboratively in a team environment
* Customer service\-oriented personality
* Impeccable attention to detail and problem\-solving skills
* B.A. or B.S. degree preferred

**Compensation:** The base pay range for this position is $31\.25 \- $34\.71/hr; however, base pay offered may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Bonuses may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a full range of benefits. Base pay is based on market location. Minimum wage for the position will always be met.


**Perks that You Need to Know About:**


Participation in our incentive programs (which may include eligible cash, equity, or commissions). Plus paid vacation, holidays, sick time, parental leave, and recharge leave; medical, tele\-health, dental and vision benefits; 401(k) plan; flexible spending accounts (FSAs); commuter program; life and disability insurance; Maven (a support system for new parents); Carrot (fertility benefits); UrbanSitter (caregiver referral network); Employee Assistance Program; and pet insurance.

  

**Do your best work, be your authentic self.**
At Compass, we believe that everyone deserves to find their place in the world — a place where they feel like they belong, where they can be their authentic selves, where they can thrive. Our collaborative, energetic culture is grounded in our Compass Entrepreneurship Principles and our commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, growth and mobility. As an equal opportunity employer, we offer competitive compensation packages, robust benefits and professional growth opportunities aimed at helping to improve our employees' lives and careers.

jobs.title: Marketing Events Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Title:** Marketing Events Coordinator
  
**Department:** Marketing
  
**FSLA Grade:** Hourly (Non\-Exempt), Part\-Time
  
**Salary:** $26\.00 \- $29\.00 per hour
  
  

**Statement of the Job:**  

Assist the Manager of Promotions \& Partnerships in planning, coordinating, and executing promotional marketing events, community activations, and partnership initiatives that support programming at Walt Disney Concert Hall, Hollywood Bowl, The Ford, and off\-site events throughout Greater Los Angeles. As a key representative of the LA Phil, this role builds relationships with community organizations, promotional partners, and audiences while delivering impactful marketing events that expand access to the performing arts and strengthen community engagement across Los Angeles.
  
  

**Estimated Event Volume:**  

This position will support 34 pre\- and post\-concert events and approximately 20 tabling/community activation events. Event volume may vary based on LA Phil’s programming, partnerships, and community engagement opportunities.
  
  

**Essential Functions:**  

* Coordinate and execute marketing events (Drinks in the Garden, Casual Fridays, Chamber Tuesdays, etc.) at Walt Disney Concert Hall and on\-/off\-site activations and partner events for the Hollywood Bowl, The Ford, and community events in Greater LA
* Coordinate with internal teams (The Music Center, Production, Hollywood Bowl Ops, Creative Services, IT, and the Community and Government Engagement) for space availability, crew needs, signage, technology, and event logistics for set ups and breakdowns.
* Coordinate planning meetings with stakeholders on a regular basis to update on production timeline, budget, and troubleshooting if necessary.
* Coordinate and oversee events on the day of, including problem\-solving, welcoming guests, directing event setup, communicating with staff, organizing vendors, and managing takedown.
* Work with supervisor to manage the budget and ensure event stays within guidelines; ensure vendors are paid.
* Coordinate and execute off\-site promotional events and community activations for the Hollywood Bowl and The Ford in collaboration with cultural organizations, community partners, and promotional partners, including Amoeba Music, Smorgasburg, and other local organizations.
* Secure additional staff as needed.
* Transport promotional materials, signage, tents, tables, giveaways, and event equipment to and from activation sites using a personal vehicle.
* Represent the LA Phil professionally while engaging with patrons, community organizations, sponsors, and promotional partners.
* Assist with grassroots marketing initiatives including brochure distribution, community outreach, Corporate Partnerships activations, and neighborhood engagement.
* Create wrap\-up reports for events with detailed notes on improvements and key findings.
* Coordinate with legal, health, and safety obligations with The Music Center or other operations staff.
* Update internal master calendar with events.
* Maintain regular and reliable attendance, including availability for assigned event dates, evenings, and weekends as required by the event schedule.
* Assist with day\-to\-day tasks for the promotions team as needed, including asset management, brochure distribution, and outreach.
* Other duties as assigned.


**Relationships:** Creative Services, Corporate Partnerships, Hope \& Grand Events by Lucques Catering, Music Center Scheduling, Production, Operations, Hollywood Bowl Food \+ Wine.
  
  

**Reports To:** Manager, Promotions \& Partnerships
  
  

**Requirements:**  

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
* Minimum of two (2\) years of experience coordinating events, marketing activations, or community outreach, preferably in the Greater Los Angeles area.
* Experience in audience development, grassroots marketing, promotions, or partnership marketing is highly preferred.
* Excellent project management, organizational, and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting strict deadlines and budgetary constraints.
* Detail\-oriented with demonstrated ability to multitask and bring time\-sensitive projects to completion.
* Capable of working as a member of a team as well as independently.
* Bilingual proficiency, Spanish is strongly preferred, as this role regularly engages with diverse communities and cultural organizations.
* Must possess a valid California driver's license, maintain a reliable personal vehicle, and have automobile insurance. This position requires travel and the ability to transport marketing materials, promotional items, signage, displays, and other event equipment to and from various venues.
* Ability to lift and transport up to 40 pounds and assist with event setup and breakdown.


**Event Schedule and Coverage:**  

* Event dates will be shared in advance. The Coordinator is expected to attend assigned events, including evenings and weekends as needed. If coverage is needed, the Coordinator must notify the Manager at least two (2\) days in advance whenever possible.

**POSITION SUMMARY**


The Membership Sales Representative is responsible for fostering a culture of belonging, health, and connection across YMCA membership and wellness experiences. The Membership Sales Representative serves as a frontline ambassador for the YMCA — welcoming all, connecting members to programs and people, helping them pursue their wellness goals, and driving membership growth and retention. Through relationship\-building, proactive outreach, and exceptional service, this position advances the Y’s mission to strengthen the foundations of community through healthy living and inclusion.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

**Membership Engagement and Belonging**

* Create a welcoming, inclusive, and supportive environment in all YMCA areas by greeting and engaging with members and guests.
* Build meaningful relationships with members to understand their goals and connect them to Y programs, wellness services, and community activities.
* Facilitate small\-group connections to enhance member belonging and long\-term engagement.
* Conduct new member onboarding sessions and wellness consultations to help members set and achieve healthy living goals.
* Respond promptly and courteously to all member inquiries, compliments, and concerns, resolving issues with care and accountability.




**Membership Sales and Retention**

* Actively promote YMCA membership, programs, and services through tours, community outreach, and referral campaigns.
* Conduct prospective member interviews, tours, and follow\-ups — closing with an invitation to join the YMCA.
* Meet or exceed individual and team membership sales and retention goals.
* Implement grassroots and digital outreach strategies to engage local communities and attract new members.
* Conduct member retention calls and exit interviews to strengthen relationships and address barriers to participation.

**Healthy Living Support**

* Support members in achieving health and wellness goals by monitoring progress, offering encouragement, and connecting them to appropriate programs.
* Demonstrate and instruct members in the safe and effective use of fitness equipment and exercise techniques as needed.
* Monitor activity in the fitness center to ensure safety, cleanliness, and a positive environment for all.

* Uphold YMCA policies related to safety, supervision, mandated reporting, and risk management.

* **Demonstrate** competencies in and willingness to develop in the Cause Driven Leadership areas of mission advancement, collaboration, operational effectiveness and personal growth.

* **Leading Operations:** ensure relevance, effectiveness, and sustainability of the organization so that we can continue to fulfill our promise to the community
	+ **Competencies Include:** Critical Thinking \& Decision Making, Fiscal Management, Functional Expertise, Innovation, \& Program/Project Management
* **Developing \& Inspiring Others:** support the holistic development of self and others so that everyone can embrace the Y’s cause, sustain the Y’s culture, and inspire others to take individual and collective action to further our impact
	+ **Competencies Include:** Emotional Maturity \& Developing Self \& Others


While all competencies are significant, the following are critical to success in this position:

* Engaging Community

jobs.title: Administrative Project Coordinator (Construction Management)
jobs.description:
Administrative Project Coordinator (Construction Management) \- (196229\)
At HDR, our employee\-owners are fully engaged in creating a welcoming environment where each of us is valued and respected, a place where everyone is empowered to bring their authentic selves and novel ideas to work every day. As we foster a culture of inclusion throughout our company and within our communities, we constantly ask ourselves: What is our impact on the world?  

  

Watch Our Story:' https://www.hdrinc.com/our\-story'  

  

Each and every role throughout our organization makes a difference in our ability to change the world for the better. Read further to learn how you could help make great things possible not only in your community, but around the world.  

  

We believe water is more than a resource, it's a shared responsibility. As part of our Water Business Group, you’ll help shape how communities manage water for generations to come. From delivering safe drinking water and treating wastewater responsibly to developing sustainable water supplies and protecting lives and property through flood control, your work will directly support public health, environmental sustainability, and infrastructure resilience. We bring together experts across disciplines to solve complex challenges with bold thinking and technical excellence. Whether you're modernizing aging systems or pioneering innovative approaches, your contributions will make a meaningful difference in people’s lives. This isn’t just a job, it's a chance to lead change, drive progress, and leave a lasting legacy.


In the role of Administrative Project Coordinator, we'll count on you to:  

* Type, format and organize project documents, reports, specifications and correspondence
* Create and maintain paper and electronic files
* Order insurance and monitor insurance certificates
* Apply company quality assurance guidelines and procedures for project document management
* Assist and help coordinate meetings and presentations
* Schedule and moderate project reviews
* Exhibit professionalism with clients
* Work with multiple Project Managers and project teams as needed
* Assist with project guides, project invoices and expense reports as needed
* Establish workshare agreements
* Develop and issue sub agreements
* Support management with coordination of cost estimating
* Job Hazard Analysis (JHA) reporting
* Assisting with change management
* Ensure accuracy and monitor workflows within Construction Management Information System (CMIS)
* Perform other duties as needed

  

This position typically requires successfully passing drug\-screening procedures prior to being hired; thereafter subject to random and cause drug and alcohol testing

**Preferred Qualifications*** Good communication and organizational skills
**Required Qualifications*** Associate degree in a closely related field or combination of education and relevant experience
* A minimum of 1 years related experience
* Proficiency in Microsoft Word and Excel
An attitude and commitment to being an active participant of our employee\-owned culture is a must  
* 

  

**What We Believe**  

HDR is our company. Together, we build on each other's life experiences and perspectives to make great things possible every day. This shapes our collaborative culture, encourages organizational trust and connects us closer to the clients and communities we serve.  

  

**Our Commitment**  

As employee owners, we all have a role in creating an inclusive environment where each of us is welcomed, valued, respected and empowered to bring our authentic selves to work every day.  

  

Our eight Employee Network Groups (Asian Pacific, Black, Hispanic/Latino(a), LGBTQ\+, People with Disabilities, Veterans, Women, Young Professionals) help create a sense of belonging and foster a supportive environment where everyone is empowered to engage and contribute. Each group has an executive sponsor and is open to all employees.


We provide a comprehensive benefits package that promotes employee ownership, employee health, performance, and success, which includes medical, dental, vision, short and long\-term disability, life insurance, an employee assistance program, paid time away, parental leave, paid holidays, a retirement savings plan with employer match, employee referral bonus and tuition reimbursement. The expected compensation range for this position is $56,000 \- $80,000 and depends upon skills, experience, education and geographical location. jobs.title: Bilingual Community Program Coordinator (Triada)
jobs.description:
Project Access provides programs and services to over 27,000 children, families, and seniors living in affordable housing communities across the country. We strive to empower residents of affordable housing communities through our onsite services, aiming to create pathways for self\-reliance and personal growth.  

  

Join the Project Access team and create impact in the lives of our residents. Hear from them and how their lives have changed: www.project\-access.org/success\-stories/

**The opportunity**


The Resident Services Coordinator designs and implements programs that enhance community life for residents of all ages. They serve as a vital link between residents and services, creating value through targeted initiatives that address community needs. This role requires an innovative, proactive individual who excels in an autonomous environment, driving positive long\-term outcomes through an understanding of the communities in which they serve.

**What you'll do**

* Implement core programs and services, which include connecting, engaging, and empowering residents across four initiatives: Economic Stability, Education for Youth \& Families, Health \& Wellness, and Community Building.
* Conduct outreach and survey resident needs through community engagement aligned with our four pillars.
* Coordinate and oversee an after\-school program and teen program encompassing homework assistance and educational enrichment activities.
* Independently plan, prepare, and facilitate resident\-facing workshops and group sessions. When external partners are unavailable, deliver core topics directly to maintain consistency and resident engagement.
* Develop \& maintain partnerships with local providers to deliver services and workshops.
* Plan \& facilitate community\-building events that foster safe and meaningful relationships between community members.
* Provide residents with information \& referrals to access community resources and services, specifically connecting residents with nonprofit partners who deliver services within our four pillars framework.
* Support food distribution needs in the community, including maintaining food bank partnerships and distribution management.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with the property management team, scheduling regular communication sessions.
* Organize and conduct monthly outreach requirements including door\-to\-door outreach, digital/virtual outreach, and physical presence in high\-traffic locations.
* Recruit, select, train, and oversee volunteers and interns who support programming at the Resource Center.
* Use personal automobile to acquire program supplies and donations and attend offsite meetings (mileage reimbursed at IRS rate).
* Publish monthly newsletters and calendar of events.
* Collect \& submit program outcomes data with emphasis on social impact data collection to measure outcomes within our four pillars.
* Provide input and adhere to budgets for resident service programs, including authority to utilize funds for contractors when needed.

**What you'll bring**

* **Bilingual English/Spanish required**
* Two years of experience in multi\-family housing or related fields such as social services or community outreach; or a Bachelor's Degree in Social Work, Human Services, or related field.
* Experience in both:
* + after\-school programs or educational settings for youth
	+ serving diverse populations, demonstrating cultural competency and community awareness
* Proficient with MS Office (Excel, Word, Publisher, Outlook). Basic with Adobe Acrobat, Canva, Salesforce, Concur.
* Strong time management, administrative, and organizational skills.
* Self\-starter, multi\-tasker, and strong communicator
* The physical activity of this position includes minimal bending, walking, kneeling, reaching, and step climbing. Able to lift up to 30 pounds, which includes large boxes of food for a supplemental food distribution program.

**Credentials/Certifications**
==============================

* Valid Driver’s License, clean driving record, and current automobile insurance
* CPR \& First Aid certified (or obtained within 90 days of hire)
* Successful completion of background check and LiveScan

**The details:**

* **This is a part\-time (29 hrs/wk), non\-exempt position**
* **Schedule:** Monday through Thursday: 11pm – 5:30pm, Friday: 12:30pm – 5:30pm. Ability to work an occasional Saturday for an event. Schedule is subject to change.
* **Location**: Triada Apartments, 616 N. Lacy St., Santa Ana CA 92701
* **Wage:** $25/hr
* **Benefits offered**:
* + Term life insurance and an Employee Assistance Program
	+ Safe Harbor 401(k) with 4% company match
	+ Pro\-rated paid time off \+ 14 paid holidays

  

Project Access, Inc. is an at\-will and equal opportunity employer, committed to creating an equitable and inclusive workplace. We value diversity in all its forms and actively seek to build a team that reflects the richness of our community. Our hiring practices are designed to identify and welcome talented individuals regardless of their race, ethnicity, cultural background, religious beliefs or practices, gender identity or expression, relationship status, age, neurotype, physical or sensory abilities, sexual orientation, military service history, or any other aspect of their identity protected by law. We believe that a diverse team leads to better ideas, more innovative solutions, and a stronger community impact. Our goal is to foster an environment where everyone can thrive and contribute their unique perspectives and skills.

25 \- 25 USD por hour (Triada \- CA)

jobs.description:
**Bilingual International Sales Coordinator**


**Ampronix, LLC \| Irvine, CA \| Full\-Time \| On\-Site**

  


**About Ampronix**



Founded in 1982, Ampronix is a growing medical imaging technology company serving customers in **138\+ countries**. We specialize in medical imaging equipment, service, refurbishment, and repair.

  


**About the Position**



Ampronix is seeking a **Bilingual International Sales Coordinator** to support our growing International Sales team.

  



This is a hands\-on sales support and customer service role working with customers, distributors, and internal teams. The position will manage customer inquiries, sales orders, follow\-up, CRM updates, shipping coordination, and other activities that support international sales. **Fluency in Spanish and English, written and verbal, is required.**

  


**Key Responsibilities**


* Support the International Sales team with daily sales activities.
* Communicate with customers, distributors, and business partners.
* Process sales orders, quotations, and customer requests.
* Track orders and coordinate shipments and delivery.
* Maintain accurate customer and sales information in CRM.
* Follow up with customers and sales leads.
* Coordinate with Sales, Operations, Purchasing, Service, and Marketing.
* Assist with international shipping and documentation.
* Support customer retention and business development activities.


**Qualifications**


* 2\+ years of sales administration, sales support, or customer service experience.
* **Fluent in English and Spanish — written and verbal.**
* Strong communication and customer service skills.
* Highly organized with excellent attention to detail.
* Experience with CRM systems and Microsoft Office.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
* International sales, shipping/logistics, or medical device experience is a plus.


**Why Join Ampronix?**


* Established company with 40\+ years in business
* International customer base
* Collaborative team environment
* Opportunity for growth and increased responsibility
* Medical, Dental \& Vision
* Employer\-Paid Life \& AD\&D
* Voluntary Life \& AD\&D
* Pet Insurance
* Paid Holidays, Sick Time \& Vacation
* 401(k) and Match


**Location:** Irvine, CA — On\-Site



If you are an organized, customer\-focused professional who enjoys working with people and wants to be part of an international sales team, we would like to hear from you.

 **Apply today and join the Ampronix team! Learn more about Ampronix at** **Ampronix.com.**

  



We look forward to meeting you!

jobs.title: Logistics Coordinator B2B
jobs.description:
**Overview**  
Safe Appliances inc. is a wholesale B2B distributor of a wide range of name brand home appliance parts and electronics. With distribution centers in the North America, Asia and Europe, Safe Appliances is a one stop shop for Appliances, Electronics, and their Accessories. Safe Appliances provides a complete solution for property upkeep, stocking all the essentials for appliances, HVAC, plumbing, cleaning, and repairs.

We are seeking a dynamic and highly organized Import/ Export Administrator to join our team! In this vital role, you will assist in day to day fulfillment operations, ensuring smooth administrative processes and exceptional support for our team. Your energetic approach and attention to detail will help streamline daily tasks, manage communications, and keep our office running efficiently. If you thrive in a fast\-paced environment and enjoy multitasking with a positive attitude, this is the perfect opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact!

**Responsibilities**

**Fulfillment \& Logistics**

● Process customer orders accurately and efficiently.

● Coordinate shipments with carriers, warehouses, and fulfillment partners.

● Prepare and review shipping documentation, including commercial invoices, packing

lists, bills of lading, and customs documents

● Monitor shipment status and provide tracking information to Sales reps.

● Support inventory counts and reconciliation activities for multiple 3PL.

● Resolve shipping issues and coordinate returns when necessary.

● Verify order accuracy and ensure timely order fulfillment.

**Administrative Support**

● Perform data entry and maintain accurate records.

● Manage email correspondence and customer inquiries.

● Prepare reports, spreadsheets, and operational documents.

● Organize and maintain company files and records.

● Assist with communication across departments.

● Support management with various administrative tasks as needed.

**Customer Service**

● Respond to customer inquiries regarding orders, shipments, and products.

● Provide timely updates on order status and delivery schedules.

● Help resolve customer concerns professionally and efficiently.

**Experience**

* Prior office experience or clerical experience in a fast\-paced environment is preferred
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Google Workspace applications
* Familiarity with inventory management and warehouse operations is preferred but not mandatory
* Bilingual abilities are highly desirable to serve diverse client needs effectively
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize tasks efficiently and manage time effectively to meet deadlines
* Excellent typing speed and accuracy for data entry and document proofreading
* Previous experience in office management or administrative support roles will be advantageous
* Ability to work independently and as a team
* Familiarity with parcel shipping platforms (UPS, FEdEX, USPS) preferred

Join us as a Fulfillment Administrative Assistant and become an essential part of a vibrant team dedicated to excellence! Your proactive approach, combined with your technical skills and enthusiasm for customer service, will help us achieve operational success while fostering a positive workplace environment.

Pay: $24\.00 \- $26\.00 per hour

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance

* Vision insurance

jobs.title: Outreach Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Outreach Coordinator (Part\-Time, 20 Hours/Week, Afternoons \& Evenings)** 

Partners4Wellness (P4W) seeks a compassionate and motivated **Outreach Coordinator** to facilitate life\-skills and resiliency workshops for youth involved in the juvenile justice system. This entry\-level position is ideal for recent graduates who are passionate about supporting under\-served youth through mentorship, skill\-building, and community engagement.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

Life Skills and Resiliency Workshops

* Facilitate interactive, evidence\-based life\-skills and resiliency workshops for youth and transitional\-age youth (TAY) ages 16\-25 in Juvenile Hall, the Youth Guidance Center, the Youth Leadership Academy, and other youth\-serving organizations.
* Create a welcoming, respectful, strength\-based, and trauma\-informed group environment.
* Provide guidance, mentorship, and support to participants, helping them develop coping strategies, problem\-solving skills, and goal\-setting techniques.
* Build positive, professional relationships with participants while maintaining appropriate boundaries and modeling effective communication and problem\-solving skills.
* Connect youth to community resources and support services that promote successful reentry.

Curriculum Support

* Maintain and update curriculum materials, participant workbooks, and community resource guides to ensure relevance and alignment with youth needs and best practices.
* Support the enhancement and occasional development of new curriculum content, workshop activities, and resource materials based on program needs.
* Stay updated on trends in youth development, trauma\-informed care, and community resources.

Community Engagement and Collaboration

* Establish rapport and maintain positive relationships with Probation staff, site coordinators, and other programming partners.
* Represent P4W at community and stakeholder meetings to promote life\-skills education for justice\-involved youth.
* Present at conferences on promoting youth mental wellness and resilience.
* Represent P4W at community outreach and tabling events to increase awareness of programs and services.

Program Reporting \& Support

* Track attendance and participation for each session, ensuring timely and accurate data entry.
* Collect youth feedback and support basic program evaluation efforts.
* Share success stories, challenges, and program updates with the Program Manager.

**Qualifications \& Experience**

Education

* Bachelor’s degree in Criminal Justice, Social Work, Psychology, Sociology, Public Health, Education, or a related field required.

**Experience \& Skills**

* Prior experience working or volunteering with at\-risk youth preferred but not required.
* Strong public speaking and group facilitation skills.
* Experience with basic data collection, tracking, and reporting.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Canva.
* Bilingual (English/Spanish) preferred.

**Additional Requirements** 

* Work schedule consists primarily of afternoon and evening hours based on program and site needs.
* Following hire, employees will be required to successfully complete a background investigation conducted by the Probation Department to obtain and maintain access to assigned program sites.
* Valid driver's license, reliable transportation, proof of automobile insurance, and documentation establishing identity and employment authorization are required.
* Regular travel to juvenile justice sites required; occasional travel to community locations, conferences, and outreach events as needed.
* Mileage reimbursement provided for approved work\-related travel.

**Compensation: $24\-$25 per hour, depending on qualifications and experience.**

Pay: $24\.00 \- $25\.00 per hour

* Please submit a cover letter with your resume.

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Marketing and Client Relations Coordinator
jobs.description:
Bohm Wildish \& Matsen, LLP, a respected estate planning and litigation firm in Orange County, invites applications for a Marketing and Client Relations Coordinator. The successful candidate will bring a blend of marketing acumen, analytical discipline, and professional polish to support the firm’s client communications, brand visibility, and business development initiatives.

**Primary Responsibilities**

– Develop and execute a formal, results\-oriented marketing plan reviewed with firm leadership regularly

– Plan and manage multi\-channel campaigns across digital, email, social media, and print

– Maintain and update firm website, social media accounts, and online directories

– Prepare newsletters, announcements, and event communications

– Manage firm CRM/database; generate KPI and lead\-conversion reports for management

Inside Sales Representative – Pharmaceuticals \& Medical Supplies

We are looking for a **highly motivated, talented, and competitive Inside Sales Representative** who wants to build a substantial book of business and be rewarded directly for the results they produce.

This is not an order\-taking position. We are looking for someone who is **hungry to win, comfortable prospecting for new business, persistent in developing new accounts, and motivated by uncapped earning potential.**

Our company sells **pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to wholesale distributors and clinics specializing in clinical trials.** You will be responsible for developing your own customer base, building long\-term relationships, and turning those relationships into repeat business.

What You'll Do

You will take ownership of your territory and customer base from prospecting through ongoing account management.

Your responsibilities will include:

* Prospecting and developing new B2B accounts
* Identifying purchasing decision\-makers and developing relationships with them
* Selling pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to wholesale distributors and clinical\-trial\-focused clinics
* Learning customers' purchasing patterns, product needs, and supply challenges
* Following up consistently on quotes, opportunities, and potential orders
* Growing existing accounts through repeat business and additional product opportunities
* Maintaining strong, long\-term relationships with customers
* Managing your sales pipeline and staying organized with follow\-ups
* Working closely with our purchasing and operations teams to identify opportunities and fulfill customer needs

As you establish a strong customer base, the position becomes increasingly relationship\-driven, with more of your time focused on managing, retaining, and expanding the accounts you have developed.

Who We're Looking For

We want someone with **B2B inside sales experience** who understands that building a successful book of business takes consistent effort.

The right person is:

* Competitive and highly self\-motivated
* Comfortable proactively pursuing new business
* Persistent without being discouraged by rejection
* Naturally good at building business relationships
* An excellent communicator on the phone and through email
* Organized and disciplined with follow\-up
* Able to identify opportunities and move quickly
* Motivated by financial success
* Interested in building something over the long term rather than simply collecting a paycheck
* Able to work independently while also contributing to a team

Experience selling pharmaceuticals, medical supplies, healthcare products, or other B2B products is valuable, but **industry experience is not required if you have demonstrated B2B sales ability and are willing to learn.**

Compensation

This position is intentionally **commission\-heavy with a smaller base salary.**

We want our salespeople to have meaningful upside when they perform. Your earning potential will be driven largely by your ability to develop accounts, generate profitable sales, and grow your book of business.

**High performers will have the opportunity to earn substantially more than they would in a traditional salary\-heavy sales position.**

What Success Looks Like

In the beginning, success means **activity, persistence, and account development.** You should expect to spend significant time prospecting, contacting potential customers, and creating new relationships.

Over time, the goal is to **build a valuable book of repeat customers.**

We want our salespeople developing relationships that produce repeat orders, referrals, larger opportunities, and long\-term revenue.

As your customer base grows, your role will increasingly shift from pure prospecting toward **managing and expanding the relationships you've created.**

This Position Is a Great Fit If...

You are the type of salesperson who looks at a commission plan and thinks about the upside rather than the guarantee.

You enjoy competing.

You like developing relationships but aren't afraid to pursue new business.

You want your income to increase as your skills, customer base, and sales increase.

And most importantly, **you want an opportunity where exceptional performance is rewarded.**

If you're talented, hungry, persistent, and ready to build a serious book of business in the pharmaceutical and medical supply industry, we want to hear from you.

jobs.description:
Join a nonprofit organization dedicated to improving our community through programs that provide equal access to legal services. The Justice \& Diversity Center of The Bar Association of San Francisco (JDC) has an exciting opportunity for a part\-time **Legal Project Coordinator** to be part of the team!

JDC is a non\-profit organization which provides free legal services through its staff and volunteers to low\-income Bay Area residents. Each year more than 1,600 volunteer attorneys, legal assistants, and law students work with JDC staff to serve nearly 7,500 indigent clients. JDC’s holistic advocacy approach seeks to address the social service and legal needs of clients.

**About the Job** 

The Legal Project Coordinator will work with JDC’s Federal Pro Bono Project, reporting to and working with the Supervising Attorney and Senior Staff Attorney. The Federal Pro Bono Project assists self\-represented litigants in two ways: (1\) staff attorneys at Legal Help Centers in the San Francisco and Oakland federal courthouses provide legal advice and guidance on federal civil cases; and (2\) the Project matches litigants with volunteer attorneys to represent them in their cases.

The position is fully remote, but office space is available at JDC’s downtown location should the successful candidate prefer to work some or all of their hours in a more social setting.

As the first point of contact for litigants communicating with the Project, the Coordinator is a critical part of the Project team. The Coordinator’s primary responsibilities are to conduct intakes and screening by phone and email, and to schedule appointments with the Project attorneys when appropriate. The Coordinator uses strong communication and organizational skills to keep the Project’s Legal Help Center legal advice work on track and ensure that litigants eligible for assistance are scheduled in a timely manner. The Coordinator also assists with outreach, database upkeep, development of resources, and improvement of best practices.

**Education \& Experience:**

· Relevant education, training, and experience to perform the essential duties of the position

**Skills \& Requirements:**
