jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**About PhoenixAI**


PhoenixAI is the Agentic AI Database, purpose\-built to give autonomous AI agents sub\-second access to live enterprise data at massive scale. The platform unifies real\-time and at\-rest data in a single AI\-native engine, combining the speed and concurrency that agentic workloads demand with the governance and deployment flexibility enterprises require to put AI into production. Formerly known as CelerData, PhoenixAI is headquartered in Menlo Park, California. Learn more at phoenixdata.ai **About the role**


PhoenixAI is looking for an experienced Field Marketing Manager to own our in\-person event programs end\-to\-end. This is a senior, hands\-on role for someone who has already managed high\-stakes events at a tech startup — ideally in the data, infrastructure, or SaaS space — and understands how to allocate resources, manage vendors, and drive measurable outcomes.  

Events are a key growth channel for PhoenixAI. The current program includes a monthly technical meetup (in the Bay Area and other U.S. cities), quarterly executive receptions for key customers, and a presence at major industry conferences such as AWS re:Invent. Our events motion is anchored in the StarRocks open\-source community, and this role works closely with DevRel and Community to turn that community into a recurring, high\-quality in\-person program. This person will define clear goals for each program, execute flawlessly, and report results back to the business. **What you'll do**


The Field Marketing Manager will own the full lifecycle of PhoenixAI's in\-person events — strategy, budget, execution, and reporting — working cross\-functionally to bring the right people and content into each program.* Take full ownership of meetups, conferences, customer receptions, and partner programs from concept to close\-out.
* Build and run a monthly technical meetup program in the Bay Area and other cities, drawing speakers and co\-hosts from the StarRocks community, customers, and partners, in close coordination with DevRel.
* Plan and host quarterly executive receptions for key customers in partnership with Sales and Customer Success, focused on relationship depth, expansion, and advocacy.
* Lead PhoenixAI's presence at major industry conferences and partner events (e.g., AWS re:Invent) — sponsorship selection, booth, speaking opportunities, and on\-site execution.
* Leverage the open\-source data ecosystem — community members, other project communities, local meetup organizers — to source speakers, co\-hosts, and venues for our events.
* Define the specific objective for each event before it happens — e.g., lead generation, pipeline influence, brand awareness, or customer engagement — and design the event and its metrics around that goal.
* Handle venue selection, sponsorship arrangements, vendor relationships, catering, booth setup, signage, promotional items, shipping, and travel logistics.
* Develop event schedules and keep colleagues, speakers, partners, and vendors aligned and on track.
* Produce landing pages, invites, social content, email outreach, and other materials to promote events.
* Work with speakers on presentations, demos, and run\-of\-show planning.
* Bring in internal technical resources — such as Product Management, Solutions Architects, and Engineering — to support event content and demos where needed.
* Partner with Sales ahead of each event to define target accounts, meeting objectives, and follow\-up plans.
* Make sure leads gathered at events are logged accurately and passed along to Sales without delay.
* Capture and repurpose event content — recordings, photos, speaker decks — with the content and social teams.
* Coordinate with the team that owns webinars to align calendars and cross\-promote where in\-person and virtual programs overlap.
* Track and report on performance against the stated goal for each event (MQLs/SQLs generated, pipeline influence, awareness metrics, community growth, customer engagement, or similar).
* Keep an up\-to\-date calendar of upcoming conferences, sponsorship options, and community gatherings.

**Qualifications**

* 5\+ years of field or event marketing experience at a fast\-growing tech startup, ideally in the data, infrastructure, or SaaS space.
* Proven experience organizing events for an open\-source or developer community — running meetups, community days, contributor gatherings, or community tracks at conferences. This is required.
* An existing network in the open\-source data ecosystem (e.g., StarRocks, Apache projects, Linux Foundation events, or the broader data engineering community) that you can draw on for speakers, co\-hosts, and venues is strongly preferred.
* Track record of running events end\-to\-end in a fast\-moving, resource\-constrained environment, from large conference sponsorships to small executive hospitality events.
* Demonstrated ability to work cross\-functionally with internal technical stakeholders such as Solutions Architects, Product Managers, and DevRel.
* Strong vendor and budget management skills.
* Familiarity with event and community tooling (e.g., Luma, Bevy, Splash) and marketing automation / CRM systems (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce).
* Comfortable engaging with technical speakers, partners, prospective customers, sales, and executive leadership.
* Willingness to travel for events and work evenings/weekends as needed around event schedules.
* Must currently be based in the San Francisco Bay Area.
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  

When applying, please include 2–3 community or field events you have organized and your role in each.  

The base salary for this role is projected at $150,000 \- $200,000, plus eligibility for PhoenixAI's bonus and equity programs. Individual compensation will be determined based on permissible, non\-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic

jobs.title: Field Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About LiveKit**
-----------------

LiveKit is building the infrastructure layer for the voice\-driven era of computing. Our platform gives developers everything they need to build, test, deploy, scale, and observe agents in production. Founded in 2021, LiveKit powers voice AI applications for OpenAI, xAI, Salesforce, Coursera, Spotify, and thousands of others, collectively facilitating billions of calls each year.

**About This Role**
-------------------


Most companies that sell to developers treat events like a booth and a badge scanner. We don't. Field marketing at LiveKit exists to do one thing: put the right builders and buyers in a room, and turn that into pipeline. Over the past year we've shipped 35\+ events — dinners, meetups, conference activations — and the playbook works. Now we're hiring the person who runs it day to day. To be clear about the tradeoff: this is an execution\-heavy role. Venues, vendors, budgets, swag logistics, and follow\-up lists that actually reach sales within 48 hours. If you want to watch from the strategy deck, this isn't it. If you want to own real events end to end from week one — at the exact moment the team is scaling — keep reading.


You'll thrive as a Field Marketing Coordinator if you:

* are obsessed with making the best product for our customers
* are known as the go\-to person for tackling tough problems
* work hard and can build and ship fast
* are focused on polish, detail and quality
* are a fast learner, frequently picking up new tips, tricks, and skills


The best way to impress us is with thoughtful ways you'd support LiveKit’s GTM plan.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own end\-to\-end logistics for regional field events — dinners, meetups, and conference activations — including venue sourcing, vendor management, procurement, and on\-site execution
* Run the pre\- and post\-event sales enablement motion: attendee list hygiene, sales handoff, and follow\-up tracking within 48 hours of every event
* Track event KPIs and clearly communicate results to Sales, Marketing, and Finance
* Manage the swag and event inventory program — sourcing, warehousing, and ordering
* Provide executional support on ABM and Demand Gen campaigns where needed

**Who You Are**
---------------

* Able to travel for events across the US
* 2–4 years in event coordination, field marketing, or a comparable event\-heavy role
* Results\-oriented — you track, report, and can articulate what an event actually produced
* Strong at vendor and logistics management, and comfortable owning budgets and procurement details
* Comfortable using AI and marketing tooling to increase your output
* Able to operate independently in a fast, ambiguous environment

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* You've run events tied to a sales pipeline goal, not just general brand awareness
* B2B, dev\-tools, or infrastructure company background
* HubSpot or similar marketing automation experience
* You've personally hauled a box of swag through an airport — and would do it again

**Our Commitment to You**
-------------------------

* An opportunity to build something truly impactful to the world
* Contribute to open source alongside world\-class engineers
* Competitive salary and equity package
* Health, dental, and vision benefits
* Flexible vacation policy


LiveKit is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable law. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact recruiting@livekit.io.


Compensation Range: $102K \- $138K

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
What We Need
  
CORPAY is currently looking to hire an Account Manager within our Corpay division. This position falls under our Corpay line of business and is located in Brentwood, TN, San Mateo, CA or Beaverton, OR. In this role, you will be the primary client services contact responsible for supporting retention, client satisfaction and issue resolution of their assigned accounts. This position is responsible for assisting with all aspects of client relationships to ensure satisfaction and effective use of products and services. Account Manager is assigned a portfolio of customers and is responsible for understanding and resolving issues pertaining to products utilized by the client. A strong level of technical knowledge is needed for this position along with the ability to travel to client sites as needed. You will report directly to the hiring manager and regularly collaborate with other department/teams as needed
  
  

How We Work
  
As an Account Manager, you will be expected to work in a Hybrid environment. CORPAY will set you up for success by providing:
  
* Assigned workspace in office and home office setup
* Company\-issued equipment
* Formal, hands\-on training


Role Responsibilities
  
  

**The responsibilities of the role will include:**  

* Working directly with clients as a primary point of contact for day to day account support, problem resolution, technical clarity, research and analysis
* Responding to inbound emails, fax, and phone calls, and Salesforce cases
* Developing and executing a client service delivery strategy for assigned clients around the needs, contracts specifications and cost components
* Conducting regularly scheduled calls, presentations to review business performance, including training and education
* Making decisions regarding the set up and support of the clients assigned to their care
* Preparing and presenting solutions in advance to retain relationships
* Using customer feedback to monitor the status of service levels, identifies problems and revenue growth potential within the client base
* Effectively interacting with internal departments to support customer base
* Trouble\-shooting of client\-raised servicing issues to determine if the issue is a system issue, training issue, or client configuration.


Qualifications \& Skills
  
* Bachelor’s degree preferred; equivalent work experience required.
* One to two years’ work experience with customer servicing responsibility.
* Must be able to manage time effectively and work independently without direct supervision
* Excellent level of personal organization with superior telephone etiquette, verbal and written communication skills, as well as, customer service skills are required
* Ability to react quickly and decisively to resolve customer issues
* Demonstrated ability to work calmly in a fast\-paced team environment while effectively managing multiple projects
* Self\-driven to develop professionally, improve performance, and understand the tools in place and maximize their use.
* Demonstrates leadership qualities that influence peers to work collaboratively, automate manual processes, and use the systems available to their fullest potential.
* Serves as key contributor in developing and testing new processes and procedures that enhance the users experience.
* Acts as change agent as appropriate.


Benefits \& Perks
  
* Medical, Dental \& Vision benefits available the 1st month after hire
* Automatic enrollment into our 401k plan (subject to eligibility requirements)
* Virtual fitness classes offered company\-wide
* Robust PTO offerings including: major holidays, vacation, sick, personal, \& volunteer time
* Employee discounts with major providers (i.e. wireless, gym, car rental, etc.)
* Philanthropic support with both local and national organizations
* Fun culture with company\-wide contests and prizes


Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer
  
CORPAY is an Equal Opportunity Employer. CORPAY provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, gender (including pregnancy), religion, national origin, ancestry, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, language, ancestry, genetic information, veteran and/or military status or any other group status protected by federal or local law. jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Location**
------------


San Francisco; New York


**Employment Type**
-------------------


Full time


**Location Type**
-----------------


Remote


**Department**
--------------


GTM


**Compensation**
----------------


* $300K • Offers Equity

  
**About Us:**
-------------


**AI needs a new infrastructure layer. We're building it at Modal.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------

Every era of computing brought new workloads that previous infrastructure couldn't support: mainframes, databases, and the cloud. Each time, the company that rebuilt the layer underneath defined the decade. AI is no different, except it touches everything instead of one slice, and the window to build the layer underneath it is open right now.


Our customers include category\-defining companies like Lovable, Ramp, Cognition, DoorDash, and Suno. They rely on Modal for instant GPU access, sub\-second container starts, and native storage, so it's simple to serve low\-latency inference, fine\-tune models, and access production\-ready sandboxes at scale.


We recently raised a $355M Series C at a $4\.65B valuation, led by General Catalyst and Redpoint Ventures. We've crossed $300M\+ ARR and grown fivefold since September.


Our team includes creators of popular open\-source projects (e.g., Seaborn, Luig**i**), academic researchers, international olympiad medalists, and experienced engineering and product leaders


**About the Role**
------------------


We're hiring the first Account Managers at Modal. You'll report to the Regional Director of Account Management and be a founding member of the team.


This function does not exist yet. There is no playbook, no territory map, no established motion. You'll own a book of business from day one and build the motion at the same time — from fast\-moving AI startups to large enterprise teams running critical infrastructure on Modal.


This is a commercial role with a revenue target. You'll be measured on retention and expansion across your accounts. While you won't be delivering the technical recommendations and implementation, the work is technical by nature. Our customers are engineers running GPU workloads, inference, and batch jobs in production, and you need to hold your own in those conversations.


The profile we're hiring is a technical account manager. You've worked at companies that are deeply technical and consumption in nature. You bring the commercial instincts to grow revenue from an existing base and enough technical depth to know which conversation actually matters. And you can credibly work with a CxO all the way down to a Developer.


**What the Role Is**
--------------------


* **A founding seat.** You're helping build the AM function with us, not joining one that already runs. The account plans, expansion motions, and customer cadence you and the rest of the founding team figure out are what we scale to every AM we hire after you.
* **A technical customer\-facing role.** You'll work directly with Developers and ML teams on what they're building and how Modal fits. You translate and triage the deeper technical work to FDEs and Product when it's needed.
* **A book of business.** You’ll own a set of accounts and be responsible for the revenue that comes from them. Expect to be meeting with customers in your first few days because the best playbooks are built from real experiences.

**What the Role Is Not**
------------------------


* **A traditional post\-sales role.** You're measured on revenue, not health scores.
* **An on\-call support function.** You're not fixing bugs or triaging tickets. You're driving growth.
* **A technical delivery role.** You're not implementing for the customer. You know where the technical work goes and you pull in the right people.

jobs.title: Key Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**
==============



Concert Health is the leading national behavioral health medical group committed to integrating the Collaborative Care model into existing health care practices to improve patients' lives. We believe everyone, regardless of location or insurance, should have easy access to personalized, high\-quality behavioral health support that is guided by the provider they trust.


### **Who You Are**



You are a seasoned account leader who is energized by depth over breadth — you'd rather go deep on a smaller portfolio of complex, high\-value accounts than manage a wide book with less context on each. You build real fluency in each partner's clinical operations, stakeholders, and goals, and you use that fluency as the foundation for everything else: faster issue resolution, sharper growth strategy, and smoother provider onboarding.



You're equally comfortable being hands\-on and thinking several moves ahead. Day to day, you're the named point of contact partners trust to resolve issues and keep commitments on track. At the same time, you're building the data\-backed case for why a partner should expand, and running the onboarding plan for the next provider joining the account — moving between all three without losing sight of the relationship that ties them together.



You bring the judgment and track record of someone with 9\+ years in Account Management, Customer Success, or Client Services in healthcare, with a career trajectory into progressively larger and more complex accounts. You've driven measurable growth in existing accounts (not just retention), ideally onboarded new sites, providers, or users into a live account, and you're credible in a room with C\-suite and senior clinical leadership. Beyond your own accounts, other Account Managers look to you for how the job should be done — you set the standard, not just meet it.


### **Job Summary**



The Key Account Manager owns the complete lifecycle of Concert Health's most strategic partnerships — day\-to\-day relationship management, long\-term account growth, and the onboarding of new providers within existing accounts. This is Concert Health's most advanced individual\-contributor role in Account Management: one person, accountable end\-to\-end for a focused portfolio of high\-value, high\-complexity accounts, trusted to move fluidly between hands\-on servicing, strategic growth planning, and program\-managed provider launches without ever dropping the relationship thread.


**Core Responsibilities:**


*Own Day\-to\-Day Partner Success \& Issue Resolution:*


* Serve as the primary, named point of contact for a focused portfolio of key accounts, ensuring timely, high\-quality responses across clinical, operational, and administrative needs
* Proactively identify, triage, and resolve issues – driving toward systematic, scalable solutions rather than one\-off fixes
* Coordinate cross\-functional resources (clinical, operations, product, billing) to remove barriers and maintain momentum within each account
* Establish clear accountability, follow\-through, and communication loops so nothing falls through the cracks for your accounts
* Maintain deep, current fluency in each key account's clinical operations, stakeholders, and performance, so day\-to\-day servicing and long\-term strategy are always working from the same picture


*Grow Key Accounts*


* Own overall account performance for your portfolio – clinical, operational, and financial – with direct accountability for growth, not just retention
* Use utilization, outcomes, and financial data to identify white\-space opportunities within each key account and translate them into a concrete growth plan
* Build and pitch data\-backed growth and expansion cases to partner leadership, framing clinical outcomes and financial performance into a compelling case for investment
* Translate partner goals into actionable success plans with clear milestones and measurable outcomes, and hold both internal teams and partners accountable to them
* Lead negotiations with partner stakeholders to convert growth opportunities into signed, executed expansion


*Manage Leadership \& Executive Relationships*


* Build and maintain strong, trust\-based relationships with executive sponsors and senior clinical stakeholders at each key account
* Lead regular business reviews, presenting performance insights, outcomes, and growth recommendations
* Confidently navigate complex, matrixed stakeholder environments, aligning priorities and driving decision\-making
* Act as a strategic advisor, influencing partner leadership to invest in and expand Collaborative Care as a core model across their organization


*Set the Standard for the Function*


* Serve as a thought partner and mentor across the Account Management team, setting the bar for how account growth and provider onboarding should be done
* Define and codify the playbooks, frameworks, and best practices that other Account Managers are trained on
* Represent the voice of key accounts in product and clinical program roadmap discussions, with the credibility to shape how those roadmaps are prioritized
* Operate with a high degree of autonomy, ownership, and urgency – anticipating challenges before they arise and acting decisively to keep accounts on track


**Qualifications:**


* 9\+ years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success, or Client Services, with a demonstrated trajectory into progressively larger and more complex accounts
* Healthcare experience required
* Demonstrated success balancing hands\-on day\-to\-day account servicing with longer\-term strategic growth planning
* Proven track record driving measurable expansion or growth revenue within existing accounts, not just retention
* Experience onboarding or implementing new sites, providers, or users within an existing customer account preferred
* Strong foundational understanding of the healthcare delivery system in primary care and administrative/

jobs.title: Edge Product — Account Manager & Product Liaison - 6472305
jobs.description:
**Role Purpose**


This role sits within the Edge Product area of Accenture Global IT, acting as the primary account management and product liaison between Dell and the wider Accenture organization. The role manages the day\-to\-day Dell relationship, represents Accenture's interests in product and roadmap discussions, and ensures alignment between Dell's offerings and Accenture's internal edge, data center, and infrastructure modernization priorities.

**Key Relationships**

* Global IT Edge Compute
* Global IT IMS Leadership
* Global IT Strategy, Architecture and Innovation
* Accenture Dell Account Management Team

**Key Responsibilities**

**Dell Account \& Relationship Management**

* Own and manage the day\-to\-day relationship with Dell account contacts, acting as the primary point of contact for account\-level matters.
* Coordinate commercial discussions, including hardware pricing, licensing tiers, and contract matters, escalating decisions appropriately.
* Track and follow up on outstanding commercial items (e.g. hardware pricing, licensing tier decisions) and ensure resolution within agreed timelines.
* Support business review cycles and executive\-level engagements with Dell stakeholders.

**Internal Accenture Liaison**

* Act as the internal conduit between Dell and relevant Accenture stakeholders across Global IT, infrastructure, and edge teams.
* Support cross\-functional coordination on active workstreams, ensuring Dell\-related dependencies are tracked and communicated.
* Prepare and maintain materials (briefings, status updates) that keep internal stakeholders aligned on Dell\-related decisions and timelines.
* Flag unresolved decisions and dependencies proactively rather than allowing them to surface unaddressed to senior stakeholders.

**Product Roadmap Input \& Liaison**

* Gather and relay Dell product roadmap information relevant to Accenture's edge and infrastructure strategy.
* Provide structured input from Accenture's perspective into Dell's product planning where relationship and process allow.
* Support development of outcomes\-led, exec\-ready materials on edge infrastructure topics, translating technical detail appropriately for the audience.


Remote with with air travel associated with role 5 times a year (e.g. Conference, meetings)


  

**Here's What You Will Need**

* Minimum 5\+ years of experience in account management, partner/vendor management, or a similar relationship\-facing role, ideally with a major hardware/infrastructure vendor (e.g. Dell).
* Minimum 3\+ years of experience managing or coordinating complex, multi\-stakeholder commercial engagements, including contract governance or procurement processes.
* Minimum 3\+ years of experience with data center, edge computing, or hyperconverged infrastructure (HCI) concepts.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate's Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience.)

**Preferred Experience**

* Prior experience working within or alongside a major enterprise IT function or shared services environment.
* Familiarity with Nutanix, VMware, or similar HCI platforms, even at a conceptual level.
* Exposure to AI infrastructure, GPU compute platforms, or edge compute deployments.
* Experience supporting or contributing to vendor business reviews, RFPs, or contract renewals.
* Knowledge of IT governance frameworks or compliance processes within large enterprises.

**Professional Skills**

* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to operate across both commercial and technical conversations.
* Comfortable working with ambiguity and tracking multiple open items to resolution.
* Ability to synthesise technical and commercial information into clear, concise updates for senior leadership.
* Self\-directed with strong organisational discipline; capable of managing competing priorities across a distributed team and vendor landscape.
* Collaborative working style with the ability to build trusted relationships both internally and externally.

jobs.title: Client Account Manager
jobs.description:
Trusted empowers the healthcare workforce with technology\-first solutions to optimize the clinical workforce. By combining our AI\-powered staffing platform with dynamic labor marketplaces, we help leading employers automate the matching and fulfillment of clinical staff\-driving down labor costs and reducing administrative burden. Our mission, to help people everywhere get care, has support from top institutional investors such as Craft Ventures, Felicis Ventures, Stepstone, and Founder Collective as well as healthcare innovators like Texas Medical Center, Mercy Health, Intermountain Ventures, and Town Hall Ventures.

**What we're looking for:**


You will use your direct experience as a Recruiter or Account Manager in the Travel Nursing Industry to serve as a partner and key collaborator with our clients to understand their staffing needs. You will proactively solve problems, fill open jobs, and ultimately grow these strategic relationships to maintain and expand our business. The Account Manager will take initiative, setting objectives and creating actionable plans to deliver results. You will be a resourceful, solution oriented problem\-solver, expertly navigating areas such as how and when jobs are posted, upcoming projects or staffing challenges, what the job submission requirements are, and the interview and offer process cadence. You will remove barriers where possible and work collaboratively with the product and Nurse Advocate teams to increase our submission\-to\-offer rate. The Account Manager will be the day\-to\-day relationship support required to place and retain Clinicians.

**Your responsibilities:**

* Maintain trusted relationships with assigned clients, resulting in a 100% retention rate of current and future accounts.
* Meet assigned targets for growth.
* Develop new relationships that result in successful additions to our client roster.
* Gather and track feedback from clients and create reports on the health of relationships and opportunities for improvement.
* Collaborate with leadership on the Nurse Advocate team to improve standing with clients through higher quantity and quality of placements.
* Proactively identify and offer solutions to barriers for growth in our accounts and placements.

**Who you are:**

* **Strategic\-thinker.** You anticipate future trends, helping the team to understand and use complex analyses to achieve goals. You clearly distinguish and leverage the organization’s key differentiators, incorporating them into a solid long\-term strategy. You are highly alert to the future, developing hypotheses and enabling their team to address change, tackle challenges and capture new possibilities. You see the big picture in a relationship and know how the little things you do today to provide value can create big things down the road.
* **Customer\-focused.** You champion the needs of clients, helping team members deepen insight into customer needs. You have a long\-term understanding of client needs, building roadmaps with measurable outcomes that address current and anticipated problems.
* **Influencing \& Persuading.** You make it a priority to broker relationships and forge connections that contribute to others success and advance Trusted's goals.
* **Personable and reliable.** You can create and grow relationships with key stakeholders by providing value and meeting their needs in order to grow these relationships.

**You have:**

* 3 or more years of experience in healthcare staffing with direct experience working with RNs, either in Account Management or Recruitment, preferably at a high\-growth startup and/or a healthcare or staffing company.
* Experience in building and maintaining strategic relationships and growing a book of business with RNs through excellent presentation and communication skills with the ability to hold challenging conversations.
* Knowledge and understanding of the healthcare staffing landscape and buyers (VMS/MSP/Direct).
* Knowledge of compliance criteria and Joint Commission requirements for RN professions.
* Worked cross\-functionally and enjoy working as a team to achieve a goal.
* A High School Diploma is required, Associate's or Bachelor's Degree preferred.

**We offer:**

* Paid vacation \& sick time, paid family leave, and flexible work hours
* Employer\-paid health insurance, vision, and dental
* Employer\-paid life insurance
* Monthly cell phone reimbursement
* Employer\-sponsored 401k
* Variable compensation plan

*This is a fully remote position.*

*Trusted Health provides equal employment opportunity for all applicants and employees. All qualified applicants will be considered regardless of an individual’s race, color, sex, gender identity or expression, religion, age, national origin, citizenship, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, marital status, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local laws. If you cannot submit your application due to a disability, please email hello@trustedhealth.com; we will reasonably accommodate individuals with disabilities to the extent required by applicable law.*

jobs.title: Outside Sales Account Manager
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, US
jobs.description:
**Job Title**: Outside Sales Account Manager

Job Summary: The Outside Sales Account Manager is responsible for generating leads, cultivating client relationships within an assigned territory, and exceeding sales targets by promoting and selling our products/services. This role involves travel to meet with clients, conduct product demonstrations, and close sales.

**Key Responsibilities**:

\* Identify and pursue new sales opportunities through cold calling, email outreach, networking events, and referrals.

\* Build and maintain strong, long lasting relationships with both new and existing clients within a designed territory.

\* Conduct in person meetings, deliver effective presentations, and provide product demonstrations to showcase product benefits.

\* Guide prospects through the sales pipeline from initial contact to qualification and closing the deal.

\* Stay informed about industry trends, competitor activities, and market conditions to identify customer needs and tailor sales strategies.

\* Develop and implement strategic sales plans to achieve monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets.

\* Act as a trusted advisor to clients, providing ongoing support resolving issues to foster customer satisfaction and loyalty.

\* Maintain accurate sales activity records, client information, and sales forecasts.

\* Work closely with internal teams, including marketing and customer service, to align on sales efforts and insure seamless client experiences.

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager, AWS Enterprise Support, Strategic Industries
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  

  

Would you like to join one of the fastest\-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes including Automotive, Financial Services, Energy, Big Data, and more gain the best value and service from AWS? At AWS Enterprise Support we’re looking for a Technical Account Manager (TAM) to support our customers’ creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application\-level services, Networking, Serverless and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and ‘voice of the customer’ to organizations ranging from start\-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.  

The TAM role is not directly hands on keyboard within the customer’s environment for troubleshooting customer support issues, rather you will work with appropriate engineers and service teams to see issues through to resolution. More importantly you will work proactively to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services, including EC2, S3, DynamoDB \& RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT, and many more.  

Your technical acumen and customer\-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade\-offs, support and risk management.  

You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices, and proactively keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy and resilient. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.
  

The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!  

  

  

  

About the team  

About AWS

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3\) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
* Bachelor's degree

* Experience in internal enterprise or external customer\-facing environment as a technical lead

Our accelerated BDR program combines the best parts of a Business Development Representative (BDR), Marketing Development Representative (MDR), and Account Executive role. You'll work directly with experienced Account Executives on live deals, build and own pipeline through outbound prospecting, develop your sales skills, and work toward promotion into a full\-cycle Account Executive role within 6 months, compared with the traditional 1–2 year SDR\-to\-AE path. You'll learn how to prospect, qualify opportunities, run sales conversations, build pipeline, and sell Coram AI's physical security platform to businesses across the U.S.

  

Our second Fall 2026 cohort will start on November 2nd.

  

**Responsibilities:**

* Build and qualify pipeline through targeted, strategic prospecting
* Partner with senior AEs on live deals, from discovery to close
* Participate in and help deliver product demos to prospects and partners
* Understand and uncover customer needs and business problems to effectively communicate how Coram can solve them
* Master Coram’s platform and learn how to sell value
* Consistently outperform assigned goals and earn your promotion to a full\-cycle Account Executive title
* Ability to understand complex business environments and uncover customer issues, process problems, and translate need into business opportunities.

 **Skills and qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or Associate's degree, or relevant working experience
* We’re especially interested in college athletes and others with highly competitive backgrounds (military, performing arts, debate, high‑level competition, entrepreneurship, etc.) but this is not a requirement to apply
* A strong work ethic with a focus on winning the right way
* Motivation to win and a willingness to out‑prepare and out‑work your competition
* Intrinsically\-driven with the ability to takes initiative by default
* Coachable and curious mindset with the ability to ask questions, take feedback, and apply it to your work
* Resilient in challenging and fast\-paced environments
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English
* Ability to work in an onsite environment

 **What we offer:**

* Competitive compensation package which includes annual base salary of $60,000 \+ variable compensation of $5,000
* Clear promotion path from Associate Account Executive to full\-cycle Account Executive within 6 months
* Opportunity to relocate into any of our US offices (SLC, AZ, NYC, or ATL)
* Flexible paid time off and 10 paid holidays
* Daily team breakfast and dinner, and regular team off\-sites
* The latest Apple products and unlimited tech stack (Claude, Nooks, Clay, Instantly, etc.)
* Free onsite EV charging \+ commuter stipend
* 100% Employer\-paid medical, dental, vision, and base life insurance
* 401(k) with both Traditional and Roth options
* Early\-stage equity in a rapidly growing company
* Referral bonuses

  

We're on a mission to transform a $50B\+ legacy industry by bringing the power of cutting\-edge multimodal LLMs and computer vision to real\-world security and operations. From firearm detection to intelligent access control, our AI\-native platform turns every camera and sensor into a smart system that enhances safety, efficiency, and awareness.


Founded by Ashesh Jain (ex\-Lyft Level 5, PhD Cornell) and Peter Ondruska (ex\-Lyft, PhD Oxford), Coram AI is backed by Ansa Capital, Battery Ventures, Mosaic, 8VC and Up Partners, have raised over $65M, and were named to the CB Insights AI 100 as one of the most promising AI companies in the world. If you're excited to work on mission\-critical AI that makes an impact in the real world, we’d love to meet you.

jobs.title: Assistant Project Manager (Design and Construction)
jobs.description:
Brailsford \& Dunlavey (B\&D), which now includes Project Management Advisors (PMA), is seeking a Project Manager to join our team in San Fransico.


This is a hybrid role based in San Fransico, CA.


**The Opportunity**
===================


An opportunity for a driven project management professional who is eager to grow their career, thrives in collaborative environments, and enjoys working with innovative clients and project teams to deliver complex facilities and real estate projects.


At Brailsford \& Dunlavey (B\&D), we lead the planning, development, and management of the places that shape and strengthen communities—where people live, learn, work, and innovate. B\&D partners with institutions, municipalities, and organizations to deliver complex real estate and capital projects through strategic advisory and program management services across the full project lifecycle.


B\&D recently joined forces with Project Management Advisors (PMA), bringing together two nationally recognized leaders in program management and real estate advisory services. Together, the combined firm offers expanded capabilities across industries and end\-to\-end project delivery—from early\-stage strategy through design, construction, and occupancy.


As an Assistant Project Manager, you will support the planning, design, and construction of a diverse portfolio of facilities and real estate projects, working closely with clients, architects, engineers, contractors, consultants, and project teams. The initial focus for this role will be on Life Sciences projects, with opportunities to gain exposure to a variety of project types and sectors. You will contribute throughout the project lifecycle while developing your project management, technical, and client\-facing skills.


**How You'll Contribute**
=========================


* Support project teams throughout the planning, design, and construction process
* Assist with the coordination of project activities to ensure alignment with client objectives, schedules, budgets, and contractual requirements
* Support the development, monitoring, and maintenance of project budgets, schedules, and reporting tools
* Assist with project cost, schedule, and risk analysis and help identify potential impacts and mitigation strategies
* Coordinate with clients, architects, engineers, contractors, consultants, and other project stakeholders to support successful project delivery
* Review architectural and engineering drawings, specifications, bid documents, and other project documentation
* Support procurement activities, including the coordination of design, construction, and consultant services
* Assist with contract development, review, administration, and related project documentation
* Participate in project meetings, document action items, and follow up with stakeholders to drive accountability
* Assist with the review of potential changes to project budgets and schedules
* Support value engineering discussions and evaluation of alternative solutions
* Maintain project open\-item lists and follow up on outstanding issues
* Monitor construction activities through site observations, job walks, field reports, and other project controls
* Assist with identifying and reporting construction, safety, quality, schedule, and coordination issues
* Support project closeout activities and successful turnover to the client
* Develop strong working relationships with clients and project stakeholders while contributing to a collaborative team environment

**What We're Looking For**
==========================


* 3\+ years of project management, development, construction management, or related experience
* Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, Real Estate, or a related field
* Experience supporting the delivery of complex facilities or real estate projects
* Strong understanding of design, construction, and project management processes
* Experience supporting project budgets, schedules, contracts, and project controls
* Ability to interpret architectural and engineering documentation
* Strong organizational, analytical, and problem\-solving skills
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to collaborate effectively with clients and multidisciplinary project teams
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic, client\-focused environment

**What Sets You Apart**
=======================


* You are a proactive self\-starter who takes ownership and follows through
* You are curious and eager to learn and grow as a project management professional
* You excel at building strong relationships with clients and project stakeholders
* You bring strong emotional intelligence and communication skills to every interaction
* You are highly organized and detail\-oriented when supporting complex projects
* You approach challenges with curiosity, creativity, and a solutions\-oriented mindset
* You thrive in collaborative, fast\-paced environments and adapt well to changing priorities
* You demonstrate professionalism, integrity, and sound judgment
* You are motivated by the opportunity to work on meaningful projects and create innovative environments that support growth and success
* You are interested in developing your leadership skills and contributing to the growth of the team


**Why People Choose B\&D**


Impactful Mission  

Be part of meaningful work that helps shape the places where people live, learn, heal, work, and connect.


Learning \& Growth  

We invest in mentorship, leadership development, and continuous learning at every stage of your career.


Strong Culture  

Entrepreneurial thinking, collaboration, intellectual curiosity, integrity, and excellence drive how we work together.


Robust Benefits  

Comprehensive benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, retirement benefits, professional development support, paid time off, and more.


**Apply Today!**


To get started, our application process includes a resume

jobs.title: Associate Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Description**  



  

  

ASSOCIATE PROJECT MANAGER


This position is based in our office in multiple locations.

  

About ArchKey

  



ArchKey is one of the nation’s largest privately held specialty trade installation and integrated facility service companies. We are a leader in designing, building and maintaining electrical, technologies and specialty systems. We’re the POWER behind making the improbable possible.  

  

We’re electrifying the nation, energizing the future and bringing communities to life like never before. What we do today shapes the vision of tomorrow. Our work impacts lives long after the building is done. This means we are committed to building in ways that are not just technologically advanced, but sustainable, scalable and equitable by all. We’re not just energizing infrastructure, we’re energizing careers, communities, and the future.

  

Made up of the brightest minds in the industry, our team is our greatest asset, bringing knowledge, skills, and experience to every project. This is more than a call to join us, it’s an invitation to be part of a visionary journey, to grow with us as we scale.

  

About the Position

  

As an Associate Project Manager, you will assist the Project Manager in the overall administrative and technical direction for one large complex project or direct smaller size projects under the supervision of a Project Manager. Assistant Project Managers may have overall bottom\-line responsibility for profit and loss, and consequently carry the authority appropriately, and will provide technical and engineering support as required by the project assigned.

  

Day in the Life

  

* Assist in the total construction and design effort (if applicable) to ensure project is constructed in accordance with design, budget, and schedule.
* Act as a liaison to coordinate communication between both internal and external members on the project. Including, but not limited to, General Contractors, Subcontractors, Superintendents, and Foremen.
* Assist the Project Manager in the authorization and/or approval of all project staffing including, but not limited to, choice of superintendent, general foremen, and foremen.
* Perform specialized estimating and assists in estimating projects.
* Assist the Project Manager with purchase requisitions, payment approvals, and change order requests.
* Assists in the implementation/interpretation of safety programs and ensures that all OSHA requirements are met.

  

Minimum Qualifications

  

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Construction Management, or related field.
* Minimum 0\-1 year of construction and/or project experience OR knowledge of construction methods.
* Project Managed training, experience or skills with a general understanding of a project lifecycle.
* Strong process orientation, analytical and mathematical skills.
* Superior communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Outstanding interpersonal and team leadership skills.
* Must possess strong attention to detail and ensure maximum quality of work throughout the lifecycle of the project.
* Must be willing to travel to and potentially temporarily relocate to project locations.
* Experience with Accubid a plus.
* Experience with Bluebeam Revu a plus.

  



  

**Salary Range**  

* $65,000 \-$104,000 annually, based on location, experience and qualifications.


Benefits

  

At ArchKey Solutions, our benefits package includes competitive health insurance options (medical, dental, and vision), a robust 401(k) retirement savings plan with employer match, paid time off and holidays, and access to wellness programs. Additionally, we offer professional development opportunities, tuition reimbursement, and employee assistance programs to support your growth and well\-being. We ensure that our benefits are designed to promote the health, security, and work\-life balance of our employees. Additional information is available at Archkey.com.

  

Legal \& Fraud Disclaimer

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. We are an Affirmative Action, Equal Opportunity Employer. *\#MN70\-6*

  

Beware of fraudulent job postings. ArchKey Solutions only communicates through official channels. All official communication will come from an @archkey.com email address and we will never ask for financial information, payments, or personal details outside of the standard hiring process. To confirm the legitimacy of a job, visit our careers page or reach out to a member of our Talent Acquisition team. \#MO1\-10

jobs.title: Charity Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About NYRR**


New York Road Runners (NYRR) was founded in 1958 when a small group of passionate runners vowed to bring running to the people and has grown from a local running club into the world’s premier community running organization. NYRR’s vision is to build healthier lives and stronger communities through the transformative power of running.  



NYRR’s year\-round offerings of races, community events, programs, and training resources provide hundreds of thousands of people with the motivation, know\-how, and opportunities to start running and keep running for life. NYRR’s premier event, the famed TCS New York City Marathon, attracts the world’s top professional runners and committed amateurs alike, while also raising millions of dollars annually for charity and driving economic impact for New York City. NYRR is equally committed to the runners of tomorrow, passionately providing youth fitness programs that educate and inspire children in underserved communities in New York City, nationwide, and around the world.

  



Headquartered in New York City, NYRR is a 501(c)(3\) organization. To learn more, please visit **www.nyrr.org**.  

*At New York Road Runners, we are committed to building an inclusive, diverse workplace by finding the best candidate for the job. We understand that skills come from a variety of different backgrounds. Checking off every single requirement on our job description is not necessary to apply. If you think you are a good fit and have a passion for the work we do, please submit your application. We are eager to learn about your experience and skills! You may be the right candidate for this or other open positions.*

  



*New York Road Runners is an Equal Opportunity Employer*

 **About the Department**


The Strategic Partnerships \& Runner Products Department includes the Business Development and Strategic Partnerships team, the Runner Products and Services team, The Strategic Partnerships \& Runner Products Department includes the Business Development and Strategic Partnerships team, the Runner Products and Services team, and the Professional Athlete Group.

  

The Business Development and Strategic Partnerships team secures and manages mission\-aligned partnerships providing revenue, value\-in\-kind and strategic support for advancing NYRR's mission. The team collaborates across NYRR departments to maximize partnership value and runner engagement through strategic programming. Additionally, the department oversees licensing of NYRR IP rights, including production of co\-branded product and apparel.

  

The Runner Products and Services team enhances the training, racing, and community experience through in\-person runner training, tailored customer service, and community engagement at the NYRR *RUN*CENTER. NYRR’s Official Charity Partner Program includes more than 600 official charity partners raising over $80 million annually, while the International Tour Operator (ITO) Program spans 100\+ countries and brings more than 13,000 international runners to the TCS New York City Marathon each year.

  

The Professional Athlete Group develops and manages programs for professional and sub\-elite runners, including wheelchair athletes, working closely with athletes, agents, coaches, and federations, and leading recruitment strategies for elite participation in NYRR events.

 **About the Position**


The Charity Program Coordinator will support the Charity Program Team in managing relationships with Official Charity Partners and planning and executing Charity Partner activations surrounding premier New York Road Runners events, including the TCS New York City Marathon and United Airlines NYC Half.

 **Job Responsibilities***(primary and secondary duties)***:**

* Support contracting and invoicing of Charity Partners, including creating, sending, tracking, and updating Sales Force database
* Support account set\-up and maintenance in NYRR registration system
* Assist with planning and provide event support at special events surrounding the TCS New York City Marathon
* Provide customer service support to charity partners and runners through email, phone, and in\-person at events
* Support development of program materials such as user guides and newsletters
* Provide general program support as needed

 **Job Requirements:**


*Experience:*

* 1\+ years of relevant work experience
* Experience working at or with non\-profits a plus

 *Skills and Attributes:*

* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Power Point, Outlook)
* Strong attention to detail
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Experience with Salesforce and/or NetSuite preferred
* Ability to interact in a professional and friendly way with diverse groups
* Ability to work occasional weekends or evenings
* Strong commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion

 *Other Requirements:*

* All staff are required to work the United Airlines NYC Half Marathon, RBC Brooklyn Half Marathon, and the TCS NYC Marathon.
* Operate on a hybrid schedule, with two days per week in the NYRR office in NYC

  



Salary: $58,500

jobs.title: Events & Administrative Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**

Established in 1857, AIA New York is the oldest and largest chapter of the American Institute of Architects, boasting over 5,500 members including architects, allied professionals, students, and design enthusiasts. The chapter is committed to design excellence, public outreach, and professional development. The Center for Architecture, inaugurated in 2003 as the first cultural institution within the AIA network, aims to be the premier hub for learning about architecture and urbanism in New York City. Through various programs and events, it fosters engagement among architects, professionals, and the public. Both AIA New York and the Center for Architecture advocate for the importance of design in enhancing urban life. They prioritize values such as civic engagement, equity, environmental sustainability, resiliency, technological innovation, and inspiring design.

**Job Summary:** 

The Events \& Administrative Coordinator is responsible for managing the Center’s calendar, overseeing the execution of internal events and third\-party rentals that occur at the Center, managing the organization’s Board meetings, and some office administration. Reporting to the Director of Finance and Operations, the Events \& Administrative Coordinator works closely with the Executive Director, Membership Team, A/V Team, Facilities team, and other personnel as required. Daily responsibilities are both administrative and operational. The Events \& Administrative Coordinator is an energetic professional who doesn't mind wearing multiple hats. Experienced in handling a wide range of administrative duties and executive support\-related tasks and able to work independently with little or no supervision. Well organized, flexible, and enjoys the challenges of supporting an office of diverse people.

**Duties/Responsibilities:**

*Calendar, Space, and Operations Management (30%):*

· Manage the CFA’s master calendar of space bookings, coordinating across all departments to ensure up to date.

· Serves as main point of contact and maintains institutional knowledge of all events, meetings, exhibitions, and other programs that happen at the Center.

· Supports the organizations to ensure the registration process for each event runs efficiently.

· Schedule, train, and supervise part\-time CFA Front Desk staff, and ensure they are completing daily tasks and special projects.

· Some office administration tasks, including but not limited to: distributing mail, maintenance of office equipment, ordering supplies with reference to organizational budget.

· With Director of Finance \& Operations, oversee daily operations of office equipment, including photocopier and postage meter, etc.

*Executive Director/Board/Senior Management Support (10%):*

· Manage the Executive Director’s calendar and daily schedule and ensure that the Executive Director and his office are prepared for meetings.

· Book travel, lodging, and meal reservations for Executive Director, senior management, and Board members as needed.

· Manages Executive Director’s American Express monthly reports.

· Some email and phone correspondence on behalf of the Executive Director is required, mainly in the areas of scheduling meetings, meeting follow\-up tasks, and logistical inquiries.

· Lead the scheduling, follow\-up, and execution of all meeting invites in both office calendar and in Zoom meeting rooms.

· Coordinate scheduling and prep work for AIANY and CFA Board meetings, including the dissemination of materials and information required by Board members to participate in said meetings.

· Creates and maintains up\-to\-date board lists, maintains working knowledge of Board members.

· Responsible for the creation and distribution of agendas and supplemental materials for all Board meetings \& select Committee meetings (approximately 25 per year, virtual/hybrid/ onsite).

· Attends all Board meetings to take minutes.

· Drives the creation of annual Board binders, liaises with appropriate staff members to collect information needed.

*Event Operations and Rental Business Development (60%):*

· Work closely with the A/V Manager, Membership Team, Facilities Manager, and Director of Finance \& Operations to ensure that staff and resources are properly planned for events.

* Schedule catering, beverage service, floor plans for internal programs and events taking place in the Center.

· Manage events on\-site, assisting with set up, as needed.

· Manage inquiries, sales pipeline, and billing for event space rental clients.

· Ascertain space and run of show information from clients, coordinate physical set up with facilities staff, communicate and book appropriate A/V support, and serve as staff host for rental events.

· Responsible for budgeting and cash flow of space rentals, reporting information to Director of Finance \& Operations.

**Education and Experience:**

· Bachelor’s Degree

· 2\-3 years’ work experience in an office management or administrative role.

· Excellent computer skills, particularly with Microsoft Office . Experience with Salesforce is a plus.

· A proven track record of supporting senior management and organizational leaders.

· Ability to manage multiple schedules, including predicting the needs of leaders and meeting/event attendees for various appointments.

· Solid interpersonal communication skills, organizational skills, and attention to detail, paired with persistent follow\-through.

· Ability to multi\-task. This means you are able to receive many incoming tasks and requests, prioritize them, and effectively complete them.

· Ability to have some flexibility in work schedule, with some evening and weekend work required.

· Office coordination, particularly within the events industry and /or a cultural or nonprofit institution

**Additional Information**

Location: This is a predominantly in person role, with some remote work possible (up to approx. 2 days per week, depending on event and programmatic need

jobs.title: Sales Coordinator
jobs.description:
iHeartMedia  



Current employees and contingent workers click here **to apply and search by the Job Posting Title.**

  



The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it! iHeartMedia, **the number one audio company in America**, reaches 90% of Americans every month \- a monthly audience that’s **twice the size of any other audio company** – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad\-supported music streaming service. In fact, we have:

* **More \#1 rated markets** than the next two largest radio companies combined;
* **We’re the largest podcast publisher**, with more monthly downloads than the second\- and third\-largest podcast publishers combined. Podcasting, the fastest\-growing new media, today has more monthly users than streaming music services or Netflix;
* iHeart is **the home of many of the country’s most popular and trusted on\-air personalities and podcast influencers**, who build important connections with hundreds of communities across America;
* We create and produce some of **the most popular and well\-known branded live music events** in America, including the iHeartRadio Music Festival, the iHeartRadio Music Awards, the iHeartCountry Festival, iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina and the iHeartRadio Jingle Ball Tour;
* iHeartRadio is the **\#1 streaming radio digital service** in America;
* Our **social media footprint** is 7 times larger than the next largest audio service; and
* We have **the only complete audio ad technology stack in the industry for all forms of audio**, from on demand to broadcast radio, digital streaming radio and podcasting, which bring data, targeting and attribution to all forms of audio at an unparalleled scale. As a result, we’re able to combine our strong leadership position in audience reach, usage and ad tech with powerful tools and insights for our sales organizations to help them build success for their clients at a more efficient cost than any other option.


Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity. Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.


Only one company in America has the \#1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!


If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

  



**What We Need:**


We’re looking for a Sales Coordinator to support our sales team in delivering exceptional client service. You’ll help manage the pre\- and post\-sale process, coordinate campaign execution across platforms, and ensure everything runs smoothly behind the scenes. The ideal candidate is detail\-oriented, collaborative, and thrives in a fast\-paced environment.  



**What You'll Do:**

* Responsible for understanding and supporting the sales process/procedures used by iHeartMedia Sales teams
* Enter and revise orders
* Submit special billing requests
* Work with Account Executives to generate proposals
* Respond to Account Executive requests regarding spot times
* Assist the sales team with sales material creation \& recaps

  



**What You'll Need:**

* Previous experience in a sales support or operational support role
* Strong organizational skills and ability to prioritize and multitask in a fast\-paced environment
* Technical aptitude with knowledge of Salesforce, and Veritone a plus
* Experience with the Microsoft Office suite (Excel, Outlook, Word)
* A great attitude, flexibility, and creativity!
* An understanding of media sales or strong desire to learn about media sales
* Bi\-lingual in English and Spanish is a plus
  



**What You'll Bring:**

* Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return
* Full proficiency and understanding of job function
* Open communication with colleagues and direct reports that encourages collaboration and team consensus
* Strong problem solving skills
* Efficiency with independent work under minimal guidance
* Commitment to process improvement for overall team effectiveness
* Professional communication that stresses diplomacy, empathy and patience

 **Compensation:**

  

Salary to be determined by multiple factors including but not limited to relevant experience, knowledge, skills, other job\-related qualifications, and alignment with market data.

  

$17\.30 \- $21\.63

  



**Location:**


New York, NY: 125 West 55th Street, 10019  



**Position Type:**


Regular  



**Time Type:**


Full time  



**Pay Type:**


Hourly  



**Benefits:**


iHeartMedia’s benefits offering is flexible and offers a variety of choices to meet the diverse needs of our changing workforce, including the following:

* Employer sponsored medical, dental and vision with a variety of coverage options
* Company provided and supplemental life insurance
* Paid vacation and sick time
* Paid company holidays
* A Spirit day to encourage and allow our employees to more easily volunteer in their community
* A 401K plan
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) at no cost – services include telephonic counseling sessions, consultation on legal and financial matters, emotional well\-being, family and caregiving
* A range of additional voluntary programs, such as spending accounts, student loan refinancing, accident insurance and more!

  



We are accepting applications for this role on an ongoing basis.


The Company is an equal opportunity employer and will not tolerate discrimination in employment on the basis of race, color, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, disability, ethnicity, national origin

jobs.title: Production Coordinator
jobs.description:
Overview : PRG is the world’s leading technology provider within the entertainment and events industry. Our mission is to bring together the power of our people with our production and rental expertise to deliver unforgettable events. PRG has the largest inventory of production equipment for hire and offers a complete 360\-degree range of services to clients within the live events industry. These include music touring and festivals, TV \& Film, Theatre, Sports and E\-sports and Corporate live events. **Full\- Time Outreach Coordinator\- VITA Program**

About Ariva

Ariva helps residents of New York City build financially empowered and prosperous lives. Our mission is to bring economic justice, opportunity and inclusion to our Bronx neighbors and other underserved New Yorkers. We offer free income tax preparation assistance and comprehensive financial capabilities services at locations across New York City. Information on our projects and programs can be found at www.ariva.org

Our goal is to understand the needs and experiences of the people we serve and to provide customized financial capabilities services to support their financial well being. Our staff, volunteers, and community partners offer honesty, reliability, care, and kindness in every interaction with our clients.

If our work and culture are a fit for you, we urge you to join our team!Tax Program

We are the most established free tax preparation community\-based organization in the Bronx, with 14 sites, including three\-year\-round locations. We help eligible New York City residents file their tax returns and claim credits such as the Earned Income Tax Credit and Child Tax Credit. Since 2003, we have prepared free tax returns for more than 152,000 clients, returning over $239 million in total refunds to underserved communities.

All of Ariva’s tax program staff and volunteers are IRS\-certified. All of our tax sites are sponsored by the IRS VITA program.

We are seeking an Outreach Coordinator to work on the ground in Bronx neighborhoods where our tax sites are located to promote our program with Ariva’s target clients (lower income Bronx residents living and working in the communities where our sites are located). Reports to: Director of Finance \& Operations

The Events \& Administrative Coordinator is responsible for managing the Center’s calendar, overseeing the execution of internal events and third\-party rentals that occur at the Center, managing the organization’s Board meetings, and some office administration. Reporting to the Director of Finance and Operations, the Events \& Administrative Coordinator works closely with the Executive Director, Membership Team, A/V Team, Facilities team, and other personnel as required. Daily responsibilities are both administrative and operational. The Events \& Administrative Coordinator is an energetic professional who doesn't mind wearing multiple hats. Experienced in handling a wide range of administrative duties and executive support\-related tasks and able to work independently with little or no supervision. Well organized, flexible, and enjoys the challenges of supporting an office of diverse people.  

  

**Duties/Responsibilities:**  

  

*Calendar, Space, and Operations Management (30%):*  

  

* Manage the CFA’s master calendar of space bookings, coordinating across all departments to ensure up to date.
* Serves as main point of contact and maintains institutional knowledge of all events, meetings, exhibitions, and other programs that happen at the Center.
* Supports the organizations to ensure the registration process for each event runs efficiently.
* Schedule, train, and supervise part\-time CFA Front Desk staff, and ensure they are completing daily tasks and special projects.
* Some office administration tasks, including but not limited to: distributing mail, maintenance of office equipment, ordering supplies with reference to organizational budget.
* With Director of Finance \& Operations, oversee daily operations of office equipment, including photocopier and postage meter, etc.

  

  

*Executive Director/Board/Senior Management Support (10%):*  

  

* Manage the Executive Director’s calendar and daily schedule and ensure that the Executive Director and his office are prepared for meetings.
* Book travel, lodging, and meal reservations for Executive Director, senior management, and Board members as needed.
* Manages Executive Director’s American Express monthly reports.
* Some email and phone correspondence on behalf of the Executive Director is required, mainly in the areas of scheduling meetings, meeting follow\-up tasks, and logistical inquiries.
* Lead the scheduling, follow\-up, and execution of all meeting invites in both office calendar and in Zoom meeting rooms.
* Coordinate scheduling and prep work for AIANY and CFA Board meetings, including the dissemination of materials and information required by Board members to participate in said meetings.
* Creates and maintains up\-to\-date board lists, maintains working knowledge of Board members.
* Responsible for the creation and distribution of agendas and supplemental materials for all Board meetings \& select Committee meetings (approximately 25 per year, virtual/hybrid/ onsite).
* Attends all Board meetings to take minutes.
* Drives the creation of annual Board binders, liaises with appropriate staff members to collect information needed.

  

  

*Event Operations and Rental Business Development (60%):*  

  

* Work closely with the A/V Manager, Membership Team, Facilities Manager, and Director of Finance \& Operations to ensure that staff and resources are properly planned for events.
* Schedule catering, beverage service, floor plans for internal programs and events taking place in the Center.
* Manage events on\-site, assisting with set up, as needed.
* Manage inquiries, sales pipeline, and billing for event space rental clients.
* Ascertain space and run of show information from clients, coordinate physical set up with facilities staff, communicate and book appropriate A/V support, and serve as staff host for rental events.
* Responsible for budgeting and cash flow of space rentals, reporting information to Director of Finance \& Operations.

  

  

**Education and Experience:**  

* Bachelor’s Degree
* 2\-3 years’ work experience in an office management or administrative role.
* Excellent computer skills, particularly with Microsoft Office. Experience with Salesforce is a plus.
* A proven track record of supporting senior management and organizational leaders.
* Ability to manage multiple schedules, including predicting the needs of leaders and meeting/event attendees for various appointments.
* Solid interpersonal communication skills, organizational skills, and attention to detail, paired with persistent follow\-through.
* Ability to multi\-task. This means you are able to receive many incoming tasks and requests, prioritize them, and effectively complete them.
* Ability to have some flexibility in work schedule, with some evening and weekend work required.
* Office coordination, particularly within the events industry and /or a cultural or nonprofit institution

  

**Additional Information**  

  

Location: This is a predominantly in person role, with some remote work possible (up to approx. 2 days per week, depending on event and programmatic needs on site)  

  

Salary Range: $65,000 \- $75,000
  

  

Benefits: We offer a competitive benefits package including low or zero cost health, dental and vision insurance options, 3% 401k match, 15 days PTO per year in your first five years (20 days after five years), 10 paid holidays, Summer Fridays, and the last week of the year off.  

  

Physical Demands: Some lifting (up to 30 lbs.). Prolonged periods of standing and/or walking.  

  

APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS: To apply, please send a cover letter and resume in PDF format to \[email protected]. Please put the job title and your last name on the subject line of your email. No phone calls, please.
